Context: Achievement name
Name for a boss in act 1 (named after sagittarius)
Story premise for Sagittaire
EN: 萨吉泰尔曾是卡登斯帝国的司法大臣，如今她抛开沉闷的文书工作，投身新主的前锋阵线。仿佛那颗坠落的星辰亲自为她擢升了职位。
Ori: Previously a Minister of Justice in Imperial Cadens, Sagittaire has left her stuffy clerk profession to join the vanguard front of her new allegiance. It's as if the falling star itself granted her a promotion.

Context: Event NPC Name
Event NPC Name
Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 钱，钱，钱。我们大家不都是为这个来的吗？这座集市归钱商们经营，那这位神当然也想要钱，一定没错！陶罗·德尔·梅尔卡托只要尽可能敛财就能取悦星辰，那就先从这儿所有的店铺开始吧……
Ori: Money, money, money. That's what we're all here for, right? This market was run by the moneymen, therefore this God wants money, surely! All Tauro del Mercato needs to do to appease the Star is to gain as much capital as possible, starting with all the shops here...

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 斯科皮斯向来不喜欢人，所以才会被派到荒郊野岭看守一座山丘。这山丘是干什么用的，他们心里纳闷——这地方必定有极重要的战略价值！既然星辰要他们守住这座山丘，斯科皮斯就会用性命去守。
Ori: Scorpius never liked people, which is why they were sent out to the boonies to guard a hill. What is this hill for, they wonder, having the place must be a very strategic advantage! If the Star wants them to guard this hill, Scorpius will guard it with their life.

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 认识莉布拉的人都习惯与他们保持距离。莉布拉清楚这一点，却毫不在意，因为他们始终知道真相：那些对他们说的话并非来自「幻听」，而是星辰本身。他们能在这座桥的另一端听见那些声音——啊，他们快到了，声音正越来越响！
Ori: Those who know Libra tended to keep them at arm's length. Libra was aware of this, but was undisturbed, since they've always known the truth. The words that are spoken to them are not from 'voices', but from the Stars themselves. They can hear them from across this bridge, oh they must be arriving soon, the voices are getting louder!

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 这里没什么可疑的，一点都没有。阿奎里斯只是个孤独的可怜人，在寻求帮助。他从来没有把旅人引入陷阱当作祭品，一次都没有！别多想……那你还在等什么？去帮帮他吧！
Ori: Nothing suspicious here, nothing at all. Aquarius is simply a lonely victim, looking for help. He's never lured travellers into a trap for ritual sacrifice, not once! Don't worry about it... So what are you waiting for? Go help him!

Context: Name for a boss in act 2
Story premise for Aries
EN: 自帝国创立以来，卡登斯帝国便由阿里斯皇帝的家族统治。阿里斯与高天圣庭结盟甚密，一向痴迷于星辰与星辰的魔法，渴望将这份荣光播撒四方。许愿时可得当心。
Ori: Emperor Aries's family has ruled Imperial Cadens since its founding. Closely allied with the High Firmament, Aries has always been fascinated by the Stars and their magics, wishing to spread their glory far and wide. Be careful what you wish for.

Context: Event NPC Name
Event NPC Name
Event NPC Name
Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 星辰如此慷慨地赐给维尔戈一座城堡。唯一的问题是，那里已经有人住了。真麻烦，看来只好强行把人赶走了。这一定是星辰的本意。
Ori: The Star has so graciously granted Virgo a castle. The only problem is, someone already lives there. How troublesome, perhaps they shall be removed by force. Surely this is what the Star intended.

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 武尔图尔是卡登斯的一名小伯爵。王室对他并不陌生，但他很少在自家宅邸之外露面。事实上，星辰坠落之前他的宅邸似乎就已经被封死了，真是凑巧。
Ori: Vultur is a minor count of Cadens. He is familiar to the royal family, but isn't seen very much outside of his home. In fact, it's almost has if his home was barricaded before the Star fell, how fortuitous.

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 这些知识……已经都不需要了。这些都不是真正的智慧，这样的恩赐只由星辰、且仅由星辰赐予！它该被烧掉，全部烧掉。用火焚毁都算是便宜了这等亵渎之物。
Ori: This knowledge... None of this is need anymore. None of this is real wisdom, such a blessing is granted by the Star and the Star alone! It should burn, all of it should burn. Destruction by fire is more than this blasphemy deserves.

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 啊！要是皮斯克斯不把碎片全部捡回来，星辰可怎么原谅他们。不，不不，这是一场灾难！别担心，星辰，皮斯克斯会把你重新拼好的，马上就好！
Ori: Ah! How will the Star every forgive Pisces if they don't pick up all its pieces. No, no, no, this is a disaster! Don't worry, Star, Pisces will put you back together, real quick!

Context: Name for a boss in act 1
Story for a boss in act 1
EN: 如果大地上到处都是卡登斯的饰物、徽记和礼仪，人们还怎么知道谁才是主宰？星辰要求的是正统！是正确！当真正的万物之主应当光辉到烧穿苍穹时，让某个帝国的旧日残影压在所有人头上，就是不对。把这些东西全清掉！全埋进土里！
Ori: How is everyone supposed to know who's in charge if the land is covered in Cadens trinkets, insignias, and ceremony? The Star demands legitimacy! Correctness! It's just not correct to have the reminder of some Empire's past hang over everyone, when the real ruler of all should be so bright they burn the heavens. Get rid of it all! Bury it beneath the earth!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 基拉本以为天塌下来的那天就是自己的死期，全靠她敬爱的教官牺牲才活了下来。从那以后，她发誓要向星辰以及一切与它腐朽有关的人和物复仇。
Ori: Kira thought the day the sky fell would be her last, if it wasn't for the sacrifice of her beloved trainer. Since then, she's sworn revenge on anybody and anything related to the Star and its rot.

Context: Character story
Ori: Let's kill anybody who gets in our way!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 蕾米莉亚不忠于任何特定的宗教。她过去在众多神明之间轮番膜拜，想找到那位最终能把她的技艺从「好」推向「极佳」的神。有人说她该趁早收手免得惹祸，也有人说她根本不需要任何神的加持。
Ori: Remilia is not loyal to any particular religion. She has cycled her worship through many Gods in the past, looking for the one that would finally push her skills from good to great. Some say she should stop before she gets in trouble, others say she doesn't need the support at all.

Context: Character story
EN: 唉，这位新神反正对我也没什么用。
Ori: Eh, this new God wasn't working for me anyways.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 奥斯卡本以为眼睛受伤之后，自己的战斗生涯就此结束了。这样的消沉本该让他成为星盲症的绝佳目标，但眼看德里瓦斯托的村庄被教团信徒洗劫，他重新燃起了斗志——拔剑，去完成他痛揍敌人的宿命。
Ori: Oscar thought his fighting days were over after injuring his eye. Normally, this depression would make him a prime victim for Starblindness, but seeing his Drivastian village raided by Acolytes of the cult has filled him with the motivation to take back up the sword and fulfil his destiny to kick ass.

Context: Character story
EN: 我以为这一天永远不会来了。都给伟大的奥斯卡让路！
Ori: I thought this day would never come. Make way for Oscar the Great!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 没人知道阿莉娅从哪儿来。她就在坠星事件前后突然出现在阿斯特雷亚，随时准备砍倒任何靠近她的信徒。既然她干得这么漂亮，最好还是别多问。俗话说，别对送上门的礼物挑三拣四。
Ori: Nobody knows where Alia came from, as she just suddenly appeared in Astrea around the time of the Falling Star event, ready to cut down any Acolyte that approaches her. Probably best not to ask, since she's so good at it. Don't look a gift horse in the mouth, as they say.

Context: Character story
EN: 只管给我指个方向，剩下的交给我。
Ori: Just point me in the right direction, I'll handle the rest.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 保罗从小就自称和平主义者——其实那只是他为自己不敢挺身而出找的借口。如今被逼到绝境，他意识到想活着出去，就得长出点骨气来。
Ori: Since he was young, Paul was a pacifist. Well, that's what he told himself as the reason as to why he could never stand up for himself. Now that his back is against the wall, he realizes he must grow a spine if he wants to make it out alive.

Context: Character story
Ori: I... I'll do what I can.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 一个卑微的骑士想回到已被摧毁的故乡「夺回一切」？阿妮亚拉登上那位老兵的船时心里这么想着——祝你好运吧。不过话说回来，她总归用得上多一双手，去接那些档次太低、不值得她亲自出手的活。
Ori: A paltry knight looking to return to her destroyed homeland to 'take it back'? Good luck, Aniara thinks, as she boards the old soldier's ship. Regardless, she could always use an extra hand to take the fights that fall too far below her.

Context: Character description
EN: 阿妮亚拉不理会正统，在可接受范围的边缘活得如鱼得水。为追求力量，她绕过、颠覆、违反、反叛过她遇到的每一条规则。为此她来到阿斯特雷亚，要把星尘据为己有。
Ori: Unconcerned with orthodoxy, Aniara thrives on the fringes of the acceptable. In her quest for power, she has skirted, subverted, contravened, and rebelled against every rule she has come across. In turn, she has come to Astrea to take control of the Stardust for herself.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 哦嚯，阿妮亚拉在港口遇上了同路人？不是同一片土地的人，却怀着同样的理念。若果真如此，那会是位好盟友。若不是……处理掉他们大概也不难。
Ori: Oho, could Aniara have found a compatriot at port? A person not of the same land, but of the same ideals. If so, they could be a good ally. If not, then it probably shouldn't be too hard to dispose of them.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 她并没被这个迷人男子的花招骗到，但此人身上有某种东西，让阿妮亚拉愿意假装上当。也许是他肩上那只猫吧。反正他看起来无害，暂时让他跟着也无妨。
Ori: She doesn't fall for this charming man's guile, but there's something about him that motivates Aniara to feign credulity. Maybe it's the cat on his shoulder. He seems harmless regardless, might as well let him tag along for now.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 无所谓。阿妮亚拉觉得，所有道路最终都会通向她的真正目的地：星尘的源头本身。
Ori: No matter, Aniara feels all roads will eventually lead to her true destination: the source of the Stardust itself.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 公主？哪门子的公主？阿妮亚拉俯视着这位对自己帝国的境况一无所知的战法师。不过，让她自己去发现会更有用。眼下，她能帮阿妮亚拉引路，找到星尘的源头。
Ori: A princess? Of what? Aniara looks down at the Battlemage who is completely unaware at the state of her Empire. It's more useful to let her find out on her own, though. For now, she can help guide Aniara to the source of the Stardust.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 有个奇怪的女孩跟阿妮亚拉跟得有点太近了。换作平时，阿妮亚拉懒得理会这种看起来弱不禁风的人，但她能感觉到，这女孩温顺的外表下潜藏着某种奇异的力量。
Ori: There's a strange girl following Aniara a little too closely. Normally Aniara would not bother with someone so weak-looking, but she can sense a strange power lurking underneath the girl's meek exterior.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 阿妮亚拉清楚信奉一位神能带来多大的力量，于是立刻登上了一艘许珀里翁的战舰，假意宣誓效忠他们的志业。这些确实会是强有力的盟友。
Ori: Recognizing the power that patronage to a God can grant, Aniara promptly boards a Hyperion warship, pretending to pledge to their cause. These will be powerful allies indeed.

Context: Character losing
EN: 直到咽下最后一口气，阿妮亚拉都没想过自己会在战斗中倒下。她无畏到了最后一刻，只可惜这份自信放错了地方。
Ori: Even as she drew her final breath, Aniara never considered she would ever fall in battle. She was dauntless to the very end, but it seems her confidence was misplaced.

Context: Aniara's team name
Character motivations
EN: 港口有个看起来还算有用的小个子男人找上阿妮亚拉，自称算是名治疗师。只要他能在需要时替她处理伤口，她没理由不带上他。
Ori: A useful little man approached Aniara at port, claiming to be a healer of sorts. So long as he tends to her wounds when needed, she sees no reason not to bring him along with her.

Context: Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 这位戴着王冠的女人与阿莎同船前往她的故乡，总觉得有点不对劲。但无论她会带来什么麻烦，与阿莎的使命相比都微不足道。
Ori: There's something a little off about this crowned woman sharing passage with Azha to her homeland, but whatever problems she might bring pale in comparison to her mission.

Context: Character description
EN: 阿莎是德里瓦斯托军中的老练骑士。她中断了退休生活，回到故乡接下最后一项任务：让故乡恢复成她离开时的模样。
Ori: Azha is a veteran knight of the army of Drivasto. Interrupting her retired life, she's come back to her homeland on one last job: to bring it back to the way she left it.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 听见了吗？是偷袭？不，只是个无害的偷渡客。阿莎纳闷他们是怎么上船的。他们似乎没造成什么危害，而且去阿斯特拉必定有正当理由，于是她决定不把人扔下海。
Ori: Did you hear that? Is this a surprise attack? No, it's just some harmless stowaway. How did they get on board, Azha wonders. They don't seem to be causing any harm, and they must be going to Astra for a good reason, so she decides not to throw them overboard.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 这男人那副大笑脸后面肯定藏着什么，但阿莎并不真的想弄清楚。事实上也无所谓——只要他愿意和她一起杀教团信徒，就欢迎上船。
Ori: This man's got something hidden behind his massive smile, no doubt, but Azha isn't really interested in finding out what. In fact, it doesn't matter, as long as he kills cultists with her, he's welcome aboard.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 尽管她做这些事已经有点太老了，但没有什么能挡在阿莎和她的使命之间。
Ori: Despite the fact she's getting a little too old for this, there's nothing that is going to get in between Azha and her mission.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 咦，帝国公主居然和阿莎在同一个港口。她担心两人会起冲突，但想想两人的本心都不坏，那就让她同行吧？
Ori: Huh, there's the Imperial Princess, just at the same port as Azha. She worries about how they might butt heads, but figures both their hearts are in the right place, so why not let her join?

Context: Character motivations
EN: 港口那个温顺的女孩哀求着说自己必须去阿斯特雷亚找人，阿莎忍不住涌起一股强烈的保护欲。既然目的地相同，带上她就是了。
Ori: Azha could not help but feel an overwhelming sense of protectiveness over the meek girl at port pleading that she needs to find someone in Astrea. Might as well take her aboard, since they're headed to the same place.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 阿莎平时不关心宗教和政治，但与如此狂热的许珀里翁信徒同船，她还是不免不安。尽管如此，她仍感到希望——因为对于那个占据她故乡的邪恶教团，她的憎恨不比他少半分。
Ori: Azha doesn't normally care for religion or politics, but she can't help but feel uneasy sharing passage with such a zealous Hyperion. Despite this, she feels hopeful, as she feels just as strongly as him about the vile cult that's taken over her homeland.

Context: Character losing
EN: 阿莎终究没能享受到她期望的退休生活，但某种意义上，能为国捐躯她也算满足了。
Ori: Azha never got to enjoy the retirement she wished for, but in a way was satisfied she got to die for her country.

Context: Azha''s team name
Character motivations
EN: 战场上的经历让阿莎格外敬重治疗师、药剂师、祭司，以及一切以治愈伤口或心灵为职的人。因此她毫不犹豫地让港口那位医生搭上了自己的船。
Ori: Azha's experience in the field has given her great appreciation for the healers, chemists, priests, and any other person whose job it is to heal wounds or spirits. As such, without hesitation, she welcomes the doctor at the port passage on her ship.

Context: Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 刻托斯想不注意都难：一个女人气场逼人，为了强行登上任何开往阿斯特雷亚的船而闹得天翻地覆。幸运的是，他们借她在某艘船上造成的混乱溜了上去——不过刻托斯确信，这绝不是他们最后一次见到她。
Ori: Cetus could not help but notice a woman of immense presence causing chaos trying to forcefully board any ship head to Astrea. Fortunately, they were able to use the disruption she caused on a ship to sneak themself aboard, though Cetus was sure this was not the last they'd see of her.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 刻托斯扮成走投无路的阿斯特雷亚本地人，成功搭上了一位德里瓦斯托老骑士的船。说到底，只要善用某种民族情怀，他们知道轻易就能换来可靠的庇护。
Ori: Cetus's act as a desperate Astrean native seemed to successfully allow them passage on a ship owned by an old Drivastan knight. If anything, they know they can easily get some good protection so long as they leverage a certain flavour of nationalism.

Context: Character description
EN: 刻托斯以创业者的眼光看待坠星事件，嗅到这片土地满是「寻宝」的机会。刻托斯的偷窃手段不走寻常路，许多人根本察觉不到——比起亲手弄脏撬锁的手，他们更愿意让门把手自己转动。
Ori: Cetus has taken an entrepreneurial stance on the Falling Star event, sensing a land rife with opportunity for 'treasure hunting'. Untraditional in nature, Cetus's thievery goes unnoticed by many as they would rather have a door's handle turn itself then get their hands dirty with a lockpick.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 迎接他们的是此生见过最友善的一张脸。刻托斯惊讶地遇到一个男人，主动送上一张直航阿斯特雷亚的船票。他们很识趣地没有追问票从哪来、这人又有什么盘算，跟着走就是了。
Ori: Greeted by the friendliest face they had ever seen, Cetus was surprised to meet a man offering them an extra ticket aboard a ship headed straight to Astrea. They knew better not to ask where it came from or what the man's ulterior motives might be and just followed along.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 想想看，故乡一片混乱之中有多少无人看管的财物。唔，看来该说是「前」故乡了。就连那件特别的饰物——那件溜走了的……
Ori: Just think of all the valuables unattended amidst the chaos at home. Well, former home, it seems. Even that special trinket, the one that got away...

Context: Character motivations
EN: 中大奖了！老家来的贵族！刻托斯几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。只要能编出一套急着回去见亲人的苦情戏，他们就会显得像个模范公民，被人一路带到那个值钱的猎物面前。
Ori: Bingo! A noble from back home! Cetus can scarcely believe their eyes. If they can muster up a sob story about rushing back to dear family, they'll seem like a model citizen and get led right to that prized mark.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 「可怜的小东西。」刻托斯那颗向来封闭的心涌起一阵怜悯——他们注意到一个怯生生的女孩，试遍了每一艘船都搭不上。刻托斯一反常态地决定帮忙，把这女孩偷偷带上他们能找到的第一条船。
Ori: 'Poor thing', a feeling of pity filled Cetus's usually-closed heart when they noticed a meek-looking girl unsuccessfully gain passage on every ship she tried. Uncharacteristically, Cetus decided to help sneak this girl aboard the first boat they could.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 让刻托斯不舒服的是，他们唯一能溜上去的船竟是一艘许珀里翁圣战骑士的战舰。与满脑子职责的狂信徒同住一处令他们作呕，但只要装成无害的偷渡客，这些人大概会保护他们免遭最坏的下场。
Ori: To their discomfort, the only ship Cetus could sneak aboard was a Hyperion Crusader warship. The thought of shacking up with duty-obsessed zealots disgusted them, but if they could come across as some harmless stowaway, they'd probably protect them from the worst to come.

Context: Character losing
EN: 刻托斯的口袋空了，合约也未能履行。但最重要的是，他们始终没找到一个真正属于自己的地方。
Ori: Cetus's pockets emptied and their contract remained unfulfilled. But most importantly, they never found a place they truly belonged.

Context: Cetus's team name
Character motivations
EN: 既然溜不上任何人的船，刻托斯便对一个急着办事的势利眼使出了浑身解数。他们知道两人合不来，但只要能上岸，大概也值了。
Ori: Unable to sneak aboard anybody's ship, Cetus brandished their guile on some mission-bound snob. They know they won't get along, but it's probably worth it just to get to shore.

Context: Generic militia unit story premise
EN: 你的民兵单位不知为何没有染上星盲症，只要能把自己的土地从星尘和新兴教团手中解放出来，他们乐意加入你的事业。
Ori: Somehow unafflicted by Starblindness, your Militia Units are happy to join your cause if it means freeing their land from the Stardust and its new Cult.

Context: Generic enemy story premise
EN: 被冠以「星盲」之名的人已陷入更深的侵蚀阶段。他们不仅对星辰怀有极度的忠诚，还越来越倾向于把身体逼到极限之外。
Ori: Those with the title 'Starblind' have fallen into deeper stages of affliction. Not just intense loyalty to the Star, but also an increased inclination to push their body beyond its limits.

Context: Generic enemy story premise
EN: 天塌下来的那天，或许就是他们人生的最后一天。被蚕食记忆的星盲症所困，这些敌人会不惜一切代价去满足新主人的心意。有人会问，为什么有些人被星尘夺去性命，有些人只被夺去意志；也有人会问，这两者究竟有什么区别。
Ori: The day the sky fell might as well have been their last. Afflicted by a memory draining Starblindness, these foes will stop at nothing to serve the whims of a new master. Some would ask why some people have their lives taken by the Stardust and others only their wills, but others would ask if there is any difference.

Context: Generic other unit story premise
EN: 被压迫的民众，苟延残喘地活着。

Context: Name for a hero character
Character description
EN: 自己造士兵的好处是，想做成什么样就做成什么样。不过看来，艺术家总爱把自己更多地放进作品里。
Ori: If you make your own soldiers, you can craft them however you please. Though artists are wont to put themselves into their work more than anything, it seems.

Context: Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 哇，港口有个气场强得吓人的女人，德拉科断定她一定很有钱。她会是好骗的肥羊吗？大概不是，但乐趣不就在挑战里吗。
Ori: Whoa, there's a woman at the port with such an immense aura, Draco figures she must have some kind of wealth. Will she be an easy mark? Probably not, but in challenge lies the fun.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 老兵通常都难啃，这一位似乎尤其执着于自己的任务。德拉科一边优雅地登上她开往阿斯特雷亚的船，一边琢磨能从这位老骑士身上榨出多少油水。
Ori: Usually veterans are tough nuts to crack, but this one seems especially mission-bound. Draco wonders how much wealth he can extract from this old knight as he graciously boards her ship, bound for Astrea.

Context: Character description
EN: 远远看去，德拉科和他的猫形影不离。事实上，自从一次与神明的赌局输掉之后，受控的是他。如今他来到这片满是肥羊的土地上骗钱，好还清欠偷盗之神加莱亚的债。
Ori: From a distance, Draco and his cat seem utterly inseparable. In reality, it's him who's under her control after a divine bet went wrong. Now he's come to con a land of easy marks out of its money so he can pay off a debt to the god of thievery, Galea.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 哟，这不是个挺迷人的家伙吗？德拉科不禁觉得自己在港口遇到了同类，而且两人都以不同程度的合法性轻松上了船。
Ori: Well, isn't this a charming fellow? Draco can't help but feel he's come across a kindred spirit on the port, and both were able to easily board a ship with varying degrees of legitimacy.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 这片土地上的人，要么绝望地渴求希望，要么疯得没法好好思考。不管哪种，都是遍地肥羊的好地方。
Ori: The people of this land are either desperate for hope or too crazed to think straight. Either way, it should be a land full of easy marks.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 这才叫高价值的猎物。年轻的帝国公主，大概嫩得有点过头了。德拉科琢磨着能从她身上弄到多少财宝。
Ori: Now that's a high-value mark. The young Imperial Princess, probably a little too wet behind the ears for her own good. Draco wonders what kind of riches he can get out of her.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 那个带着一看就很贵的人偶的女孩，是出身富贵还是新贵暴发户？德拉科拿不准。不管哪种，他都闻到了猎物的味道，于是摆出最迷人的姿态登场。
Ori: Draco wonders if the girl with the expensive-looking marionettes comes from a wealthy family, or is new money. Regardless, he smells a mark either way, and makes the most charming entrance he possibly can.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 德拉科犹豫了：他有把握从一个许珀里翁信徒手里骗到根本不存在的金币吗？可没得选，别的船都不肯载他。说不定他会被自己的本事吓一跳。
Ori: Draco hesitates, is he sure he can con a Hyperion out of his non-existent gold? Well, he's got no choice, no other ship will take him aboard. Maybe he'll be surprised at what he can do.

Context: Character losing
EN: 一方面，德拉科很懊恼自己再也没能回到年轻时那享乐放纵的生活；另一方面，他总算以某种方式摆脱了债务。
Ori: On one hand, Draco was frustrated he never returned to the hedonistic life of his youth. On the other, he's finally free of his debt, in a way.

Context: Draco's team name
Character motivations
EN: 医生不是应该都挺有钱的吗？港口这位连船费都凑不出来。看着像新手，说不定是个不错的……长期投资。
Ori: Aren't doctors supposed to be somewhat wealthy? This one at port can't seem to make fare for the life of him. Seems new, maybe he could be a good... long-term investment.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 或许正如人们对德鲁伊的刻板印象，艾丝黛尔战斗的动机源于痛心：她拼命守护的森林被毁了。坠星的一块碎片转瞬之间夺走了无数家园与生命，没能当场死去的动物则慢慢患上了星盲症。她无法接受这一切，而除了直捣毁灭的源头，她已无处可求。
Ori: Perhaps stereotypically of a Druid, Estelle's motivation to fight lies in her anguish at the destruction of the forest she tried so hard to protect. In a flash, so many homes and lives were lost by a shard of the Fallen Star. The animals not immediately killed slowly went Starblind. This is unacceptable, and she has no where else to turn but directly to the source of the destruction.

Context: Character story
EN: 我们要把土地连同它的丰饶一并夺回。
Ori: We shall take back the land and its bounty as well.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 想到有可能「重置」德里瓦斯托，巴兹尔私底下还有点兴奋——当然，前提是一切顺利。他见识过这件事把重商的议会搅成什么样，希望星尘落定之后，能有一个更公平、不那么向钱看的政权取而代之。
Ori: Basil is secretly a little excited at the prospect of 'resetting' Drivasto, if things all go well, of course. He has seen the turmoil this has thrown its mercantilist council into and he hopes once the Stardust settles, a more fair, less money-focuses rulership can take its place.

Context: Character story
EN: 顺手给德里瓦斯托来一脚，我倒是不介意。
Ori: I wouldn't mind giving Drivasto a kick in the pants while we're at it.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 埃米尔爱动物，而且气炸了——这帮教团混蛋以为可以肆无忌惮地到处践踏。他们觉得自己的神有多了不起，可他们的神既不会给农田施肥，也不会给他们找衣服穿。
Ori: Emil loves animals, and is pissed some cultist assholes think they can just trample all over the place with reckless abandon. They think their god is so important, but their god doesn't fertilize their farms or source the clothes on their backs.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 艾普莉尔一直很难看清自己。不幸——或许也是幸运的是，这场危机逼着她迅速回答了所有难题，好专心反击；而这件事带来一个可喜的副作用：她的自信被抬到了前所未有的高度。
Ori: April has always had a tough time figuring herself out. Unfortunately, or perhaps fortunately, this crisis has forced herself to quickly answer all the hard questions so she can focus on fighting back, which has had the welcome side-effect of boosting her confidence beyond any level it was before.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 阿代尔不想待在这儿，可似乎也没多少选择。这是座岛，他还能怎么办——游过大海去遥远的陆地？唔，也许吧……不，最好还是留下战斗。至少这样还有活下来的机会。
Ori: Adair doesn't want to be here, but it doesn't seem like he has much of a choice. It's an island, what's he going to do, swim across the ocean to distant continents? Well, perhaps... No, it's probably best to stay here and fight. At least he has a chance to survive that.

Context: Character story
EN: 如果你能反过来保护我，我想我可以帮忙。
Ori: I suppose I can help, if you can protect me in turn.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Character story
EN: 她也明白还有别的事必须去做。对力量的追求剥去了她的人性，而她担心这份人性已经稀薄得可怕。\n    阿妮亚拉曾以为力量是赢得尊重的唯一途径，是让别人听你说话的唯一方法。但她的战斗无意间向她展示了另一种视角：敬慕可以比恐惧更强大。也许对力量的追逐只是一条捷径、一场与魔鬼的交易，而真正的强大来自你身边的人。
Ori: She also understood what other things must be done as well. Her quest for power has stripped her of her humanity, and she fears such a resource had grown frighteningly limited.\n    Aniara once thought power was the only way to gain respect. The only way to have people listen to you. But her battles had inadvertently shown her an alternate perspective: admiration can be stronger than fear. Perhaps the quest for power was a shortcut, a devil's bargain, and true strength came from those around you.

Context: Character story
EN: 可代价是什么？残存的星尘从她攥紧的指缝间溜走，永远地失去了。那正是她的目标，否则她来这里做什么？巨大的耻辱感淹没了阿妮亚拉，她不会很快忘记。\n    也许这是教团的错；也许他们举行的仪式根本不对。假如，比如说，她做出类似的举动，把另一位神明的力量引到指尖，她会不会成功？\n    只能试试看了。
Ori: But at what cost? The remaining Stardust slipped through the fingers of her tightened fist, lost forever. That was her goal, why else did she come here? A great shame washed over Aniara, one she would not soon forget.\n    Perhaps it was the fault of the cult; maybe they performed the wrong ritual. If, say, she committed a similar act that brought forth another god's power to her fingertips, would she be successful?\n    Only one way to find out.

Context: Character story
EN:
她艰难地想要接受这个事实，但对她而言它依然成立。这是必须做的。她无法控制它，它只会控制她。
    这是必须做的。
    她失去了一份足以让她近乎无敌的力量。如今她只能继续那无尽而艰辛的奥术研究，只为再尝一口甜美的力量。总有一天，没人能再阻止她。
    这是必须做的。
Ori:
She struggled to accept that fact, but it was true to her nonetheless. It had to be done. She could not have controlled it, it would have controlled her.
    It had to be done.
    It was a loss of a power that would have made her nigh invincible. Now must continue her endless, arduous research into the arcane for another taste of sweet strength. One day no one will be able to stop her.
    It had to be done.

Context: Character story
EN: 但她知道真正的使命远未结束。她当初究竟为什么要退休？她清楚自己的国家需要她，而她也需要它。\n    阿莎用余下的日子帮助族人重建热闹的集市与安静的村庄，向任何需要帮助的人伸出援手。久而久之，「乐于助人的好手」这一名声盖过了她骑士队长的身份——她欣然接受了这样的转变。\n    而如果再发生一次坠星那样的事件，她知道自己一定第一个站出来迎战。
Ori: But she knew her true mission was far from over. Why did she ever retire in the first place? She knows her country needs her, and she needs it.\n    Azha spent her remaining days helping her people reconstruct the bustling markets and quiet hamlets, lending her aid to anyone in need. Over time, her reputation as a helping hand preceded her station as a Knight Captain; a change she accepted with open arms.\n    And if anything like the Falling Star event happened again, she knew she would be first in line to fight back.

Context: Character story
EN: 而她确实结束了。她想，自己该随着这个国家一起退休了，于是安享余生。\n 阿莎再没见过她离开之后的德里瓦斯托。她也不在乎了。她毕生的心血在眼前化为乌有，显然她的帮助并不被需要。德里瓦斯托现在是谁的问题都行，与她无关。
Ori: And she was done. She figured she should retire with her country, and spent her final days in rest.\n Azha never saw what happened to Drviasto after she left. She didn't care anymore. Her life's work was undone in front of her, clearly her help was not desired. Drivasto is somebody else's problem now.

Context: Character story
EN: 但她知道自己的使命远未结束。看到那些混蛋对她的故乡做了什么之后，她没法退休。他们一个都不配活着。一个都不配。\n    阿莎用余下的日子追猎并屠杀所有残留的教团成员与同情者。等她再也找不到这些人，便转向砍杀任何胆敢轻慢德里瓦斯托的人。\n    阿莎的圣战直到她吐出最后一口气才告终，唇边沾着祖国的名字。
Ori: But she knew her mission was from over. She could not retire, not after seeing what those bastards did to her homeland. None of them  deserved to live. Not one\n    Azha spend her remaining days hunting down and slaughtering any remaining cult member or sympathizer. Once she could not find any more, she moved onto cutting down anyone who dared treat Drivasto with disrespect.\n    Azha's crusade only ended upon the drawing of her final breath, her country's name staining her lips.

Context: Character story
EN: 刻托斯做到了不可能的事。刻托斯交到了……一个朋友。或者说，若时间能给出答案，或许不止是朋友。不过这些念头并不在他们心上——他们和德拉科整天泡酒吧、顺走值钱玩意儿、在这片土地上快意冒险。\n    刻托斯从未追问德拉科口中那笔必须偿还的债。事实上，刻托斯暗自希望那是个不可能还清的天文数字，这样他们的冒险就永远不会结束。要是他们知道真相就好了……
Ori: Cetus had done the impossible. Cetus had made... A friend. Or perhaps, more than that, if time will tell. Such thoughts were not on their mind, however, as they and Draco filled their days patronizing bars, nicking valuables, and swashbuckling through the land.\n    Cetus never questioned the debt Draco claimed he had to pay. In fact, Cetus secretly wished it was an impossible amount of money, so they never had to cease their adventuring. If only they knew the truth...

Context: Character story
EN: 可他们为什么要这么做？他们什么也没得到。为一份作废的合约拿命去赌，为一些自己并不喜欢的人，为一个只会轻视他们的帝国。这是刻托斯犯过的最大错误。\n   那就去他的吧。刻托斯不再回头，逃离了新获自由的阿斯特雷亚，一头扎进荒野深处，从此再无人见过……又或许，这才是他们最大的错误？
Ori: But why did they do it? They got nothing out of it. Risking life and limb for a broken contract, people who they didn't like, and an Empire that has done nothing but scorn them. It was the biggest mistake Cetus had ever made.\n   To hell with it, then. Without looking back, Cetus fled the newly freed Astrea and flung themself deep into the wilderness, never to be seen again... Or perhaps, was that their biggest mistake?

Context: Character story
EN: 刻托斯身上有什么变了。面对新的决心，合约失败这件事甚至没在他们脑中闪过。他们曾以为自己永远找不到可以交心、共餐、共度长夜的人。可仅仅尝到一点这样的滋味，刻托斯就生出了贪得无厌的渴望。\n    于是，孤独的刻托斯、窃贼刻托斯、没出息的刻托斯，就此终结。于是，行善的刻托斯、爱热闹的刻托斯、朋友刻托斯，就此诞生。
Ori: Something changed in Cetus. The fact that they had failed their contract never even crossed their mind in the face of their new resolve. Once they thought they would never find anyone with which to relate, break bread, or spend long nights. But after getting just a taste of such an experience, Cetus grew an insatiable hunger for more.\n    So here marks the end of Cetus the loner, Cetus the thief, Cetus the ne're-do-well. Thus, here marks the birth of Cetus the do-gooder, Cetus the party-goer, Cetus the friend.

Context: Character story
EN: 刻托斯一边甩开合约失败带来的刺痛，一边带着困惑的表情回望自己的旅程。他们……交到朋友了？否认了这么多年，刻托斯终于承认：世上确实有人并不想害他们。真稀奇。\n    莫非刻托斯对人的憎恶放错了地方？那么也许，他们真正的敌人是一个自己无法融入的社会——一个他们刚刚帮忙拯救的社会。\n    尽管有了这番新认识，刻托斯依然认为弊大于利，仍旧立誓离群索居。只不过，对人类境况的怨恨少了一些。钱也少了一些。
Ori: While shrugging off the sting of failing their contract, Cetus looked back on their journey with a puzzled expression. Did they... Make friends? After years of denial, Cetus admits that, indeed, there are people out there who aren't out to get them. Curious.\n    Might it be that Cetus's hatred for people is misplaced? Perhaps then, their real enemy is a society for which they are unfit. One they just helped save.\n    Despite this new perspective, Cetus reckons that the cons still outweigh the pros, and still vows to live in isolation. Albeit, with less resentment for the human condition. And less money.

Context: Character story
EN: 而德拉科感觉很好。不是因为他输给了加莱亚，而是因为他得到了一个同谋。既然还债的过程能这么有意思，永远欠一位神的债又有什么关系？\n    后来，德拉科不再记自己还了多少。也许他早就还清了，那也无所谓。何必毁掉一件好事？\n    他唯一确定的是，刻托斯也有同样的感觉——而这件事带给他的快乐，胜过任何一枚金币。
Ori: And Draco felt good. Not because he lost his bet against Galea, but because he had gained a partner in crime. Who cares if he was eternally indebted to a god, when he could have so much fun paying it off?\n    Eventually, Draco stopped tracking how much of his debt he had repaid. Perhaps he had already paid everything back, it didn't matter. Why ruin a good thing?\n    The one thing he did know is that Cetus felt the same, and that fact brought him more joy than any gold piece could.

Context: Character story
EN: 德拉科也许输掉了与加莱亚的赌局，却得到了比金钱更强大的东西：一条出路。既然维加正在打造一把能割断他诅咒之线的刀，他就不再觉得有还债的必要。他很快就能自由了。\n    维加倒是乐在其中。这项工作既棘手又独特，而他对奥术的钻研让他更懂得欣赏自然万物。至于加莱亚，对这笔交易可完全不是这么想的。唉，反正已经不是德拉科的麻烦了。
Ori: Draco might have lost his bet against Galea, but he had gained something more powerful than money: a way out. With Vega working on a knife to sever the strings of his curse, he no longer felt the need to pay back his debt. He would be free soon enough.\n    Vega enjoyed the work regardless. It was challenging and unique, and his delve into the arcane gave him greater appreciation for the natural world. Galea, on the other hand, felt quite differently about the arrangement. Oh well, it's not Draco's problem anymore.

Context: Character story
EN: 那一天，德拉科感受到了一种从未料到的情绪：解脱。不是因为他还清了债，而是因为他不再在乎了。他让心软的一面赢了。与其为了钱毁掉无辜者的生活，不如自己受苦。\n 再说，这真的算是他的问题吗？如果他拒绝还债，那不就变成加莱亚被他缠住了，而不是反过来？反正，被拴在更糟的神身上的人多的是。
Ori: On that day, Draco felt something he never expected to feel: relief. Not because his debt was repaid, but because he ceased to care. He let his soft side win. Better he suffer than ruin the lives of innocents with money problems.\n Besides, was it really his problem? If he refused to pay his debts, didn't that make Galea stuck with him and not the other way around? There were worse gods to be chained to, anyways.

Context: Character story
EN: 蠢，蠢，蠢。他为什么要掺和进来？他凭什么以为一个饱受战乱的土地会把他想要的钱双手奉上？最糟的是，他除了自己无人可怪。\n    那么问题就出在这儿了吧？无私只会给他招来越来越多的麻烦，如今他困在坑里，看不清出路。\n    那一部分必须被割掉。他必须变得冷酷无情。拿陌生人的钱，总比拿朋友的钱容易得多。于是德拉科不再交朋友；他只谈利益，而他料想自己余下的人生会非常……有趣。
Ori: Stupid, stupid, stupid. Why did he have to get involved? Why did he think a war-torn land would hand him the money he desired? Worst of all, he had no one to blame but himself.\n    So that must be the problem then, right? Selflessness only got him into more and more trouble, and now he's stuck in a pit with no clear way out.\n    That part of him must be excised. He must become ruthless. It is much easier to take the money of a stranger than a friend. So now Draco no longer made friends; he had interests, and he figured the rest of his life would be very... Interesting.

Context: Character story
EN: 而她结束了。与帝国结束，与她的信仰结束，与她的王室身份结束。显然，权力集中于她家族那一小撮人手中，给这片土地带来的只有毁灭。哪有帝国是统治着一片片陨石坑，而不是统治人民的？\n    于是莱拉做出了选择：她的皇室血脉随父亲一同终结，帝国也随之终结。取而代之的将是一个自由的卡登斯——一个不需要她、也不需要伪神指引的卡登斯。也许到那时，这个新的卡登斯才能迎来和平。
Ori: And she was done. Done with the Empire, done with her religion, and done with her royalty. Clearly, the consolidation of power into the small group that was once her family had wrought nothing but destruction to the land. What kind of an Empire rules over craters instead of people?\n    So Lyra made a choice: her Imperial lineage ended with her father, and with it, the Empire. In its place would be a free Cadens, one that did not need her, or the wisdom of a false god. Maybe then, this new Cadens would know peace.

Context: Character story
EN: 但新女皇面前还有更艰巨的任务：重建。没有家族的支持，也没有信仰的指引，莱拉独自扛起从废墟上重建卡登斯帝国的重担。\n    与普通人并肩作战的经历，让莱拉学到了臣民的可贵视角，也深深影响了她的统治。权力不会再集中在那么少数人手里，她的人民也不会再发不出声音。\n    但愿在这套新的统治之下，这样的浩劫永远不会再发生。
Ori: But an even greater task laid ahead for the new Empress: reconstruction. Without the support of her family, or the guidance of her faith, Lyra took it upon herself to rebuild Imperial Cadens from the ground up.\n    Spending time fighting alongside the common man, Lyra had learned the valuable perspective of her subjects, which greatly influenced her rule. No longer would so much power be in the hands of so few, and no more would her people go without their voices being heard.\n    Hopefully, under this new rule, a catastrophe like this would never happen again.

Context: Character story
EN: 但她没有结束。她的工作远未完成。她倾尽一生侍奉的这个帝国在她身边崩塌，自焚成灰。她绝不会让这种事再发生一次。\n    显然，有些东西必须改变。于是莱拉掌权，以女皇之身烧尽阿斯特雷亚的其余部分，再按自己的构想重建。不再有德里瓦斯托、卡登斯或高天圣庭。分裂时他们太脆弱、太无力；而团结在她之下，他们才会强大。
Ori: But she was not done. Her work was far from over. This Empire she had dedicated her life to fell around her, burning itself to ashes. She would not let something like this happen again.\n    Clearly, something needed to change. So Lyra took charge, and used her new position as Empress to burn the rest of Astrea down and build it in her image. No more Drivasto, Cadens, or the High Firmament. Apart they were too brittle, too weak. But together, under her, they would be strong.

Context: Character story
EN: 在暴力与喧哗之中，她最终确实找到了一个人，只不过不是她想找的那一个。玛雅终于找到了自己。\n    新的身体与人生被强加于她时，她当即拒绝了。但在看到自己所做的善事之后，玛雅终于接纳了它们。再说，她原先的身体和人生对她本来也没什么好处。\n    也许这正是她一直以来想要的，只是找不到合适的思绪去理解。
Ori: In the midst of the violence and spectacle, she did end up finding someone, but not the person she wanted to find. Maia had finally found herself.\n    Since her new body and life were thrust upon her, she immediately rejected them. But upon seeing the good that she had done, Maia finally came to accept them. Besides, her old body and life weren't doing anything for her anyways.\n    Perhaps this is what she had wanted all along, but could not find the right thoughts to understand.

Context: Character story
EN:
那么，她找到了什么？只有暴力。只有更多想控制她的人。只有更深的绝望。最糟的是，她甚至找不到结束这场寻找的办法。
    有什么意义呢？她又甩不掉继续寻找的那股冲动。也许有一天，玛雅会把自己逼进一个太过危险的境地，那时她终于能得到渴望已久的了结。
    在那之前，她继续游荡。
    独自一人。
Ori:
So, what did she find? Nothing but violence. Nothing but more people trying to control her. Nothing but more despair. Worst of all, she couldn't even find a way to end her search.
    What's the point? It's not like she can shake the compulsion to keep searching. Maybe one day Maia will find herself in a situation too dangerous for her and she will finally find the resolution she craves.
    Until then, she wanders.
    Alone.

Context: Character story
EN: 那么她完成寻找了吗？可以说，算是部分完成。玛雅找到的不是某个人，而是某样东西：对生命的珍视。\n 通过善行与友善的交谈，她得以片刻抗拒那永无止境的寻找的召唤，造出一瞬的极乐。\n 遗憾的是，她觉得自己仍被诅咒着。被操纵的身体与被操纵的心智，都算不上活着，所以她继续寻找。不只是找那个人，也是在找一条让自己脱离这具木质「牢笼」的路。
Ori: So did she finish her search? Somewhat, one might say. Maia did not find someone, but rather something: an appreciation for life.\n Through her good deeds and friendly chats, she was able to resist the call of her never-ending search for a moment, creating a fleeting bliss.\n Unfortunately, she is still cursed, she feels. A puppeted body and a puppeted mind is no way to live, so she searches on. Not just for the person, but a way to free herself from her wooden 'prison'.

Context: Character story
EN: 索尔完成了他的圣战。回到许珀里翁教团后，他因做到了旭日史上无人能及之事而备受尊崇：扼杀一位敌对的神明。他被奉为圣人。\n    然而义者无休，因为这只是一段漫长生涯的开端——之后是斩下无数亵渎者的头颅、屠戮无数罪人。有人或许会想，比起一个重获新生的许珀里翁教团，星尘的蔓延说不定反而是一个更少死亡的未来。
Ori: Sol finished his crusade. Upon return to the Hyperion Order, he was revered for doing something no one else in the history of the rising sun managed to do: snuff out a rival god. He was revered as a saint.\n    However, there is no rest for the righteous, as this only marked the beginning of a long career of beheading blasphemers and slaughtering sinners. Some might have wondered, in a way, if the proliferation of the Stardust might have been a less deadly future than a newly invigorated Hyperion Order.

Context: Character story
EN: 人们不禁要想，如果当初是另一群野心勃勃的冒险者踏入迷雾，又会怎样。唉，如今已无所谓了，毕竟星尘已经永远消失了……对吧？
Ori: One wonders what might have happened if a different group of ambitious adventurers took the plunge into the fog. Alas, it doesn't matter now, since the Stardust is gone for good... Right?

Context: Character story
EN: 星辰的破碎似乎令星尘消散，露出一片心智破碎、帝国倾颓的土地。这是一段艰苦的旅程，但<CharName>做了必须做的事。
Ori: The shattering of the Star seemed to dissipate the Stardust, revealing a land of broken minds and fallen empires. It was a harsh journey, but <CharName> did what had to be done.

Context: Character story
EN: 尽管如此，维加还是失败了。他什么也没学到，只带着更多疑问和灰头土脸的羞愧离开阿斯特雷亚。他哪有脸这样回到学院？\n    他没有回去。他把自己关在满是灰尘的房间里，为过错痛苦挣扎，一次又一次想要纠正它们。可他怎么纠正得了？反复翻看残缺的旧笔记，翻到一定次数，虚空的呼唤就会找上你。
Ori: Despite everything, Vega had failed. He learned nothing, and left Astrea with only more questions and his tail between his legs. How could he return to the College with such shame?\n    He didn't. Instead, he spent his remaining days locking himself in a dusty room agonizing over his mistakes, trying again and again to correct them. But how could he? There is only so many times you can go over old, incomplete notes before the call of the void takes you.

Context: Character story
EN: 尽管没能找到解药、也没能扬名立万，维加离开阿斯特雷亚时脸上却挂着满足的微笑。为什么不呢？他学到了比任何医学知识都重要的东西——人生是一场马拉松，不是短跑。\n    回到学院，维加做好了被同僚责备的准备，没想到迎接他的只有赞誉。他是唯一一个有勇气接下不可能任务的人，而这种特质只属于最优秀、最杰出的人。
Ori: Despite failing his goal of finding a cure and making a name for himself, Vega left Astrea with a satisfied smile on his face. Why would he not? He learned something more important than any medical knowledge- that life was a marathon, not a race.\n    Returning to the College, Vega braced himself for admonishment from his peers, but to his surprise he received nothing but praise. He was the one soul brave enough willing to tackle an impossible task, a trait reserved only for the best and brightest.

Context: Character story
EN: 在得知星尘的真实本质之后，维加用余生在学院里一丝不苟地试图揭开它的秘密。他越出了医学的疆界，打开了奥术的潘多拉魔盒，走上了一条从未设想过的道路。\n    这带来一个始料未及的副作用：他因此分了心，背离了当初扬名立万的初衷……但维加的鼻子埋得太深，根本没注意到。
Ori: After learning the true nature of the Stardust, Vega spent his remaining years in the College fastidiously attempting to uncover its secrets. Beyond the realm of medicine, Vega opened the Pandora's Box of the arcane, leading him down a path he never imagined himself walking.\n    This had the unforeseen side-effect of distracting him from his studies, going against his original goal of making a name for himself... But Vega's nose was buried too deep inside his clandestine grimoires for him to notice.

Context: Name for a strong enemy
Character name
Character story
EN: 卡多不确定自己的运气算极好还是极坏。他一直想参与一场史诗般的战役，搏一次荣耀，却又怀疑自己的能力，四处寻求一切能得到的帮助。按说这种犹豫不决会让他成为星盲症的完美牺牲品，可不知为何它似乎总是绕着他走。
Ori: Cador is not sure he has extraordinarily good or bad luck. He always wished to participate in an epic battle and a chance at glory, but he is second-guessing his ability and is looking for all the help he can get. Normally, this indecision would make him the perfect victim of Starblindness, but for some reason it always seems to escape him.

Context: Character story
EN: 我不知道自己能不能帮上忙，但我会尽力。
Ori: I don't know if I can be of help, but I'll try.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 帝国战士在卡登斯军中通常地位很低，但眼看星尘蹂躏自己的家乡，加雷斯没法袖手旁观。尽管离家已久，他仍迫切地想尽力保护故乡的村庄免于这场外来的威胁。
Ori: Imperial Warriors normally rank quite low in the hierarchy of the Cadens army, but Gareth could not let himself stand idly by as the Stardust ravages his home. Despite being away for quite some time, he is desperate to do what he can to prevent his home village from this external threat.

Context: Character story
EN: 为了我的帝国和家乡，什么都行。
Ori: Anything for my Empire and home.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 玛丽亚在一对一交锋中从未尝过败绩，也没打算很快开始。她曾属于一支常被德里瓦斯托雇佣的佣兵团，时不时去「解决」与卡登斯帝国的小规模边境争端。天塌之前不久生意正日渐萧条，所以她希望自己的名声能抬高开价……当然，等一切恢复正常之后。
Ori: Maria has never once known defeat in single combat, and doesn't plan to start anytime soon. She was once part of a band of mercenaries frequently hired by Drivasto to 'settle' minor border disputes with Imperial Cadens from time to time. Business was running dry shortly before the sky fell, so she hopes her reputation can drive up her prices... Once things are back to normal, of course.

Context: Character story
EN: 我的价码一向很高，不过这次可以破例。
Ori: My rate is normally quite high, but I can make an exception.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 克莱小时候被遗弃在森林里，由狼群抚养长大，成了强大的战士……这是他们逢人便说的版本。真正让他们羞于启齿的是，他们其实有个相当善良体贴的家庭，教了他们贵族式的剑术。总有一天他们会明白，那才是更值得骄傲的事。
Ori: At a young age, Clay was abandoned in the woods and left to be raised by wolves, who reared them into a powerful warrior... Is what they'd tell everyone, embarrassed that they actually had quite the kind and supportive family who taught them noble-esque swordsmanship. One day they'll learn how much more that is to be proud of.

Context: Character story
EN: 我不想再当独狼了，让我加入你的狼群。
Ori: I'm done being the lone wolf, I'll join your pack.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 布莱恩平时喜欢从基本原理上弄清事情，但他觉得这个问题最好用剑锋来解决。也许有一天他会走上学术之路，但眼下，能为同伴当盾牌让他感到自豪。
Ori: Bryan is normally one to try to figure things out at their fundamentals, but he figures this problem is best solved with the sharp end of a sword. Perhaps one day he will be destined for academia, but for now finds pride in being his allies' shield.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Name for the final boss - a dead god
Story premise for Sagittaire
EN: 神明死去之时，会发生什么？
Ori: What happens when a God dies?

Context: Name for a hero character
Name for a basic enemy
Brainwashing the enemy
Character name
Character story
EN: 伊索尔德之所以还没被星尘夺走，全靠她那股永不熄灭的怒火。她实在太愤怒了，根本死不了。只要有人挡路，她就抓住一切机会砸碎对方的脑袋，也欢迎别人加入她的旅程。
Ori: The only reason Isolde has not been taken by the Stardust is her ever-burning rage. She is simply too angry to die. She will take any opportunity to bash the skulls in of anyone who gets in her way, and welcomes others to join her on her journey.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 达娜巴不得自己身在别处。她一直暗自羡慕众神的神秘色彩，而这位神的陨落彻底击碎了她的幻想。尽管如此，她仍怀念为帝国做边境巡逻的那些夜晚——相对太平的日子让她可以尽情仰望星空。也许她战斗的意志源自对旧日时光的眷恋，尽管她知道一切都再也回不去了。
Ori: Dana so very wishes she was anywhere but here. She has always been secretly jealous of the mystique of the Gods, and the falling of this one shattered her illusions quite thoroughly. Nonetheless, she remains nostalgic for the nights she was on border patrol for the Empire, as the relative peace allowed her to stargaze endlessly. Perhaps her will to fight comes from a yearning to take back those old days, though she knows it will never be the same.

Context: Character story
EN: 神啊，就让一切回到从前吧。
Ori: Gods, just let this all return to the way it was.

Context: Character name
Character name
EN: 多里安完全不知道发生了什么。他来这里只是为了吃的。
Ori: Dorian has no idea what's going on. He's only here for the food.

Context: Character name
EN: 我完全不知道发生了什么。
Ori: I have no idea what's going on.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 在其他人眼里，星辰坠落那天是人生中最糟的一天。对邓肯来说，那只是个普通的星期二。邓肯走遍世界，见过战争、屠杀，也见过他根本无从描述的现象。尽管阅历如此丰富，他已经很久没上过战场了。虽然年纪不饶人，他却觉得自己很快就能追上、甚至超越其他人。
Ori: To everyone else, the day the Star fell was the worst day of their lives. To Duncan, it was Tuesday. Duncan has been around the world, he has seen wars, massacres, and phenomena he cannot even begin to describe. Despite having so much experience, it's been a while since he's seen action. Despite his age catching up to him, he feels like he'll be able to catch up to, and surpass, others in no time.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 阿利斯泰尔是个爱吹牛的家伙，在酒馆里用他那些勇敢与骑士精神的故事把所有人唬得一愣一愣。只不过……他的故事没有一个是真的。他其实几乎什么都做不了。嗯，他想，现在正是让那些故事成真的好时机。
Ori: Alistair is a hot-shot, impressing everyone in the tavern with his tales of bravery and chivalry. Except... None of his stories are true. He actually can't really do much at all. Well, he guesses now is a good a time as any to actually live his tales.

Context: Character story
EN: 咱们是要敲人脑袋吗？<size=75%>那样会死人的，对吧？</size>
Ori: Are we crackin' skulls? <size=75%>That kills people, right?</size>

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Stand-in for the name of a character the player has not unlocked yet
Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 正要登船时，莱拉被一个女人粗鲁地打断——她推开所有卫兵径直走过。被拦住时，那女人向莱拉保证，她不仅来帮忙，而且会比任何人都帮得更好。
Ori: As she was about to board her ship, Lyra was rudely interrupted by a woman brushing past all her guards. When confronted, the woman assured Lyra than not only was she here to help, but she would help better than anyone else would.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 莱拉在她即将启航的港口对面，看见一位佩戴勋章的德里瓦斯托骑士。听到这位骑士恳求帮助自己的故乡，莱拉觉得自己遇到了同道中人，便欢迎她上船。
Ori: Lyra spotted a decorated Drivastan knight across the port she was about to embark from. Hearing the knight's please to help her homeland, Lyra figured she had found a kindred spirit, so she welcomed her aboard.

Context: Character description
EN: 作为阿斯特雷亚卡登斯帝国的王位继承人，莱拉因出使在外而躲过了坠星之灾。尽管身为帝国战法师实力不俗，但在领导与解决问题上，她始终依赖自己的贵族家族。
Ori: Next in line to the Throne of Imperial Cadens of Astrea, Lyra was spared from the Fallen Star while away on a diplomatic mission. Despite her strength as an Imperial Battlemage, she is ever-reliant on her noble family when it comes to matters of leadership and problem solving.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 就像从暗处浮现的幽灵，一张友善的面孔突然出现，问莱拉要去哪里。原来这位陌生来客也要回到那座遭星灾之岛上的家人身边。她必须帮他，这是她的职责。
Ori: Like a phantom emerging from the shadows, a friendly face suddenly appears and asks Lyra where she is headed. It turns out this stranger-turned-passenger is also trying to return to their family on the star-stricken isle. She must help them, it is her duty.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 登船时，她遇到一个魅力无穷的男人，承诺能提供远超她想象的助力。想到岛上可能有什么在等着她，她立刻邀请他上船。任何帮助都欢迎。
Ori: While boarding her ship, she came across a man who was boundlessly charming, promising assistance beyond her wildest dreams. Afraid of what might greet her on the isle, she promptly invited him aboard. Any help is welcome.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 「再说，」她想，「只要回到父亲身边，我们就能一劳永逸地把事情扳回正轨。」
Ori: 'Besides', she thinks, 'Once I reach my father's side, we can set things right once and for all'.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 莱拉匆匆穿过港口，差点被一个怯生生的女孩绊倒——那女孩正在找去阿斯特雷亚的办法。女孩说自己是去岛上找人，莱拉认为出手相助是自己的贵族职责，便带上了她。
Ori: Rushing through the port, Lyra almost tripped over a meek girl looking for a way to get to Astrea. The girl claimed she was looking for someone on the island, which Lyra considered it her noble duty to help, so she brought her along.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 途中，莱拉不禁注意到一个男人身上散发着强烈的气场，他坚决要帮助任何人对抗那神秘的威胁。起初她还有些不安，但最终认定：敌人的敌人就是朋友。
Ori: On her way, Lyra could not help but notice an intense aura emanating from a man very determined to help anyone fight against the mysterious threat. Initially uneasy, she concludes any enemy of her enemy is her friend.

Context: Character losing
EN: 莱拉再也没能回到家人身边，也始终不知道他们的真实境况。最终她的姓氏湮没于历史，她的帝国如风中尘埃般消散。
Ori: Lyra never returned to her family and never got to know of their true state. Eventually her family name was lost to history, and her Empire faded away like dust in the wind.

Context: Lyra's team name
Character motivations
EN: 出港途中，莱拉觉得自己撞上了好运：一个身穿学者服饰的男人正想方设法挤上任何驶往阿斯特雷亚的船。她决定带上他——任何帮助都欢迎。
Ori: On her way out of port, Lyra strikes what she sees as good fortune: a man in academic adornment trying to force his way onto any ship sailing for Astrea. She shall take him along, any help is welcome.

Context: Character name
Character name
EN: 凯尔曾以为自己是那个要改变世界的人。在一切急转直下之前，他正在组建一支叛军，打算潜入帝国首都，一举推翻王室。一方面，这次事件也许终于能实现他的目标；另一方面，他宁愿那是自己亲手做的。
Ori: Kell thought he was the one that was going to change the world. Before everything went south, he was putting together a team of rebels to infiltrate the Imperial capital and take down the Royal Family once and for all. On one hand, this event might finally accomplish his goal. On the other hand, he wishes he did it himself.

Context: Character name
EN: 我可以信你，对吧？你也可以信我。
Ori: I can trust you, right? You can trust me.

Context: Character name
Character name
EN: 巧合的是，戴尔当时正要揭开众神及其力量的一桩可怕秘密。帝国高层肯定在密谋什么——星辰偏偏坠落在这里，绝不可能是巧合。起初他为研究被打断而失望，后来转而觉得，这是一生一次直面神明的机会。
Ori: Coincidentally, Dyer was just about to uncover a hideous secret about the Gods and their powers. The Imperial powers were up to something, surely, it can't be a coincidence the star fell here of all places. Initially disappointed his research was interrupted, he's come around to the idea that this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to stare a God in the face.

Context: Character name
EN: 这事绝不像表面看起来那么简单，我知道！
Ori: There is more to this than meets the eye, I know it!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 杰西卡早就等不及要冲出那间无聊的老书房，朝坏人甩法术了。终于，终于！学魔法如果不能真把人炸飞，那还有什么意义？
Ori: Jessica could hardly wait to burst out of her boring old study to start slinging spells at some bad guys. Finally, finally! What's the point of learning how to cast magic if you can't blow someone up for real?

Context: Character story
EN: 你想让我把谁炸飞？别客气。
Ori: Who do you want me to blow up? Don't be shy.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 迈克尔觉得自己想做这件事。可真的是吗？他觉得自己应该做，但也许并不该。这有点压力，可这很重要，他想。他总得把本事用在什么地方，对吧？如果他干脆离开、去过更简单的日子，会有关系吗？他会允许自己那么做吗？
Ori: Michael thinks he wants to do this. Or does he? He thinks he should, but perhaps he shouldn't. It's a little stressful, but it's important, he thinks. He's gotta use his skills for something, right? Would it matter if he just left and lived a simpler life? Would he let himself?

Context: Character story
Ori: Okay, I can take it from here.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 笑着撑过去就好，别让他们看出你心里在崩溃，拉维妮娅这么想着。如果所有人都觉得你害怕，他们就会杀了你！只要显得冷静自若，他们就不会来招惹你。一边笑一边杀人，看起来就很正常，对吧？
Ori: Just smile through it, don't let them know you're freaking out inside, Lavinia thinks. If everyone thinks you're scared, they'll kill you! Just seem cool and collected, then they won't mess with you. Smiling while killing makes you look sane, right?

Context: Character story
EN: 当然！我可喜欢这儿了！哈哈！
Ori: Of course! I love it here! Haha!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 玛雅不明白这个气势逼人的女人为什么这么执着于她。女人说会帮她找到那个特定的人，但她觉得这底下藏着别的动机。
Ori: Maia doesn't understand why this imposing woman is so drawn to her. The woman says she will help Maia find her certain someone, but she feels that there is an ulterior motive hidden beneath.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 玛雅怎么都甩不掉那位在她身边殷勤照料的老骑士。她忍不住承认自己在找某个人，而这似乎让这位老兵把她的任务当成了自己的事。
Ori: Maia can't do anything to shake the old knight fawning over her. She couldn't help but admit that's looking for a certain someone, and that seems to have caused this veteran to take her up on her mission.

Context: Character description
EN: 作为一位傀儡大师的女儿，玛雅追随父亲的脚步，亲手制作了人形的人偶。她更愿意躲在他们身后与人打交道，因为她连和自己都难以交谈。
Ori: As the daughter of a master puppeteer, Maia has followed in her father's footsteps by building her own human-like marionettes. She much prefers to hide behind them to deal with people, as she has trouble talking to anyone, even herself.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 玛雅松了口气：帮她找到去阿斯特雷亚的船的人，似乎除了自己谁都不关心。但愿他们别把她寻找某人的执念误当成真正的情感。
Ori: Maia feels relief that the person helping her find passage to Astrea doesn't seem to care about anything but themself. Hopefully they don't mistake her compulsion to find a certain someone as a true feeling.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 不行，她必须抗拒。港口这个男人太像……他了。玛雅被拉扯向两个方向：她的心完全不想理会这个在港口试图讨好她的人，可那股执念却让她无法抗拒地被吸引过去。而他偏偏声称会帮她找到某个人。
Ori: No, she must resist. This man at port is too much like... him. Maia is pulled in two directions as her heart wants nothing to do with the man attempting to charm her at port, but her compulsion feels too drawn to him to resist. He claims he'll help her find a certain someone, unfortunately.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 玛雅只希望，等他们上岸之后，自己能终于被彻底放过。
Ori: Maia just wishes that, once they reach shore, she will be left alone once and for all.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 也许这位贵族能帮上忙，玛雅在港口看到一位佩戴勋章的战法师时这么想。她不习惯与王室相处，可那股执念太强，让她没法不去请求公主帮忙找人。
Ori: Maybe this noble can help, Maia thinks as she spots a decorated Battlemage at port. She isn't used to being around royalty, but her compulsion is too strong to not ask the Princess for helping finding a certain someone.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 这男人太强了，这男人太疯了。港口这个男人，也许正是玛雅无法抗拒地想要踏上那趟通往地狱的单程旅行的完美同伴。
Ori: This man is too strong, this man is too crazy. This man at port might be the perfect companion on a one-way trip to hell Maia can't help but feel compelled to visit.

Context: Character losing
EN: 玛雅咽下最后一口气时，脸上浮现出一抹奇异的满足微笑。她其实从来就不想找到任何人。
Ori: A strange smile of satisfaction stretches across Maia's face as she drew her last breath. She never really wanted to find anyone after all.

Context: Maia's team name
Character motivations
EN: 医生是玛雅最不想同行的人，但看起来她也没多少选择。也许上岸之后很快就能分开——只要他别对帮她找人这件事太感兴趣。
Ori: A doctor is the last thing Maia wants to travel with, but it doesn't look like she has much of a choice. Maybe they can separate shortly after reaching shore, so long as he doesn't get too interested in helping her find a certain someone.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 盖尔一向喜欢抹去自己的行踪，每隔几年就想把自己的过往擦干净。他真的叫「盖尔」吗？他一直都是武僧吗？他来自德里瓦斯托、卡登斯帝国，还是别处？他真的忠于这位领袖吗？如果这一切莫名其妙地让他躲过了星盲症，那又有什么关系呢？
Ori: Gael has always liked to hide his tracks, attempting to erase his history every couple years. Is his name really 'Gael'? Has he always been a Monk? Is he from Drivasto, Imperial Cadens, or elsewhere? Is he really loyal to this leader? Does it really matter if all this has somehow allowed him to escape Starblindness?

Context: Character story
Ori: Just this once, then I'm gone.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 科马克的梦想一直是在乡下找个地方安顿下来，当个抄书人，在宁静的田园里安安稳稳地写字度日。在星尘之下，这样的抱负绝无可能实现，所以他觉得这问题只有一个解法：把这一切都清除掉。
Ori: Cormac's dream was always to settle down in some rural abode and become a scribe, spending his time peacefully scribbling away in the serene countryside. Such an ambition is impossible to accomplish within this Stardust, so there's only one solution to that problem he figures: get rid of it all.

Context: Character story
EN: 我们就不能找个安静的好地方歇一歇吗？……好吧。
Ori: Can't we just find a nice and quiet place to rest? ...Fine.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 玛蒂才刚开始搞懂「人生」这回事，这该死的世界就要完蛋了。算了吧，也许这就是一种成年礼？就像每个人到了青春期都得跟一个黑暗教团打一场游击战一样。
Ori: Maddy was just starting to figure out this whole 'life' thing before the whole godsdamned world had to end. Oh well, maybe this is just a right of passage? Like, everyone has to fight guerilla warfare against against a dark cult, like puberty.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 盖伊什么都无所谓。在修道院里修习正念？很好。屠杀那个想占据他土地的教团？也行。帮这些所谓的「英雄」理清明显属于私人问题的纠结？盖伊觉得挺好。
Ori: Guy's cool with just about anything. Practising mindfulness at the monastery? Great. Slaughtering the cult trying to take over his land? Sure. Helping these so-called 'heroes' work through what is clearly personal problems? Sounds good to Guy.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 亚历克斯其实从没想过要当武僧，他们一直梦想成为世界级的武术家。遗憾的是，他们从来没有这方面的天赋，不过强大的心智也算是一种慰藉。也许有一天他们能像那些高手一样挥拳，但他们想，在战场上，为了活命用什么手段其实都无所谓。
Ori: Alex never actually wanted to be a Monk, instead they always dreamed of being a world-class martial artist. Unfortunately, they never had the aptitude for it, but still found solace in having a strong mind. Maybe one day they'll throw blows like the greats, but they figure on the battlefield, it doesn't really matter what you do to survive.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Character name
Character story
EN: 塔莉娅会告诉你，她的眼睛是在一场为世界而战的史诗战役中受伤的；但真相是某个平静的傍晚她狠狠摔了一跤。她一直为自己至今平庸的人生感到羞愧，如今终于有机会证明自己，成为她一直向往的灵巧斥候。
Ori: Thalia will tell you she injured her eye in an epic battle for the sake of the world, but she really lost it after a nasty trip one peaceful evening. Always embarrassed at how boring her boring her life has been so far, she finally has the chance to prove herself as the skilled Scout she always wanted to be.

Context: Character story
EN: 终于，终于！我可以向全世界证明自己了！
Ori: Finally, finally! I can prove myself to the world!

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一向相当内敛的布丽吉特，始终挣扎着想成为她心目中那个能打动帝国战法师公主的英雄。也许正是这份对莱拉的仰慕，把她从星盲症的深渊里拉了出来，推上了前线。
Ori: Bridget, usually quite reserved, has always struggled to be act the hero she imagined would impress the Empire's Battlemage princess. This admiration for Lyra may have been the sole motivation to pull her out of the throes of Starblindness and into the front lines.

Context: Character story
EN: 我——我不确定自己行不行……但我必须向公主证明自己。
Ori: I- I'm not sure I can... but I must prove myself to my Princess.

Context: Character name
Character name
EN: 这是文第一次敢拿起刀剑。作为一名幸存者，她别无选择只能反击。另一个选项是面对虚无。她想，这选择很容易，而且她似乎还挺有天分。
Ori: This is the first time Vin has ever dared to pick up the blade. As a survivor, she has no choice but to fight back. The other option is to face oblivion. Easy choice, she figures, and she seems to have a knack for it.

Context: Character name
EN: 不知道自己凭什么配得上这一切，但我收下了。
Ori: Not sure what I've done to deserve this, but I'll take it.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 艾什从不喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点，这让他们非常适合当斥候。某种意义上，战争让他们比从前住在繁华市中心那间拥挤的房子里时更加与世隔绝。如今他们可以待在敌我战线的外侧。嗯，在杀戮间隙感觉还不错。
Ori: Ash never liked being the centre of attention, making them very fit to be a Scout. In a way, war allows them to be more isolated than they ever were in a cramped house in the centre of a busy city. Now they can be on the outskirts of both enemy and ally lines. Well, it's nice in-between all the killing.

Context: Character story
EN: 好，只要时不时让我溜开一会儿就行。
Ori: Okay, as long as you let me sneak away from time to time.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 妮拉的技巧只有她的决心能盖过。这帮教团信徒以为自己是谁，敢这样闯进她的家乡？她从没见过他们，如今她想让他们只看见她的鞋底。
Ori: Nera's skill is outshined only by her determination. Who do these cultists think they are bursting into her homeland like this? She's never seen them before, and now she wants them to see only the bottom of her shoe.

Context: Character story
Ori: You don't have to tell me twice.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Name for an advanced enemy type
Brainwashing the enemy
Character name
Character story
EN: 浮士德一直想成为岛上某所学院的教授。「哪所学院都行，」他会说，「只要有人肯收我。」遗憾的是，他的专长从来不是能上战场的实用技艺。「也许这能补齐我的本事」，是他紧紧抓住的一个模糊希望。
Ori: Faust always wanted to be a professor at an academy on the isle. 'Any academy', he would say, 'anyone that will take me'. Unfortunately, his specialty was never field-ready practical application. 'Maybe this will round out my skill set', is a vague hope to which he clings.

Context: Character story
EN: 我想我可以出去走走、见见世面。哦，顺便帮点忙。
Ori: I suppose I could travel and see the sights. Oh, and help I guess.

Context: Character name
Character name
EN: 天塌之前，艾莉卡才刚开始对学业上心。她一直拖延功课，终于攒够动力拿起笔来，偏偏就被这场意外打断了。她相信老师们不会介意她又一次迟到，说不定还会因为她顺手救了学校而给她加点平时分。
Ori: Erika was just coming around to her studies right before the sky fell. Constantly slacking on her schoolwork, she had finally mustered up the motivation to put quill to paper before being serendipitously interrupted. She's sure her teachers won't mind her being a little late yet again, and will probably give her a little extra credit for saving the school in the process.

Context: Character name
Ori: Let's just get this over with.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 吉尔花了大量时间研读历史。她总是一次次沉浸在古代暴君、遥远种族和古老宗教的故事里。你知道吗，曾经有个长着翅膀的种族，还有长着兽耳的种族。唉，她一直希望能亲眼见到那样精彩的时代。她运气可真好啊，是吧？
Ori: Jill has spent a lot of time reading history. She continuously finds herself lost in the throes of old tyrant kings, far-off races, and ancient religions. Did you know there was a race of people with wings, and one with animal-like ears? Alas, she always wished she could see such interesting times. Just her luck then, eh?

Context: Character story
EN: 好——好的！你觉得他们会把我写进史书吗？
Ori: O- okay! Do you think they'll include me in the history books?

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 托马斯从没见过这么多人聚在一起，更别说真正的战斗了。尽管身为学者，他从未进过正规学院，全靠自学。即便如此，他渊博的学识与那些所谓「受过教育」的同侪相比毫不逊色，有时甚至更胜一筹。
Ori: Thomas has never seen this many people at once, let alone real combat. Despite being a Scholar, he never went to an accredited academy, and instead taught everything himself. Nevertheless, his wealth of knowledge matches and even sometimes exceeds his so-called 'educated' peers.

Context: Character story
EN: 好，我做得来。我能帮上忙。
Ori: Okay, I can do it. I can help.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 尤妮卡很喜欢她在一间积灰的图书馆深处读到的旧故事：一位才华横溢的谋略家，与一个诬陷他入狱的国王开战。她一直想参与这样的传说，觉得眼下发生的事也差不多够格——尽管比起真正上阵厮杀，她更愿意读她的故事。说不定这一次背后也有一位邪神？
Ori: Yunica is fond of an old story she read in the back of some dusty library, about a brilliant tactician fighting a war against a king that falsely imprisoned them. She always wanted to take part in such a tale, and figures whatever's happening now is close enough, though she'd rather read her tales than actually take part in the fighting. Maybe an evil god is behind this one, too?

Context: Character story
EN: 请带上我，我想看的东西有很多。
Ori: Please take me along, there is a lot I wish to see.

Context: Character name
Character story
EN: 一位勇敢高贵的英雄，踏上讨伐大恶的旅程。赫特雅习惯了身陷陌生境地，但这一次实在离谱：自己怎么到这儿来的？为什么变成这副模样？尽管如此，赫特雅依然平静。他们知道自己很快就会回到来处——毕竟死亡从来没能把他们困住。
Ori: A brave and noble hero on a quest to vanquish a great evil. Hetja is used to finding themselves in unfamiliar situations but this one takes the cake. How did they get here? Why do they look like this? Despite this, Hetja is calm. They know they will return to whence they came soon, as death has never been a force that has kept them down.

Context: Character story
Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 最不圣洁的异教徒！一个可怕的女巫竟想加入他的使命？她浑身散发着伪神的腐臭，但只要让她见识神圣的真理，她就会成为强大的盟友。
Ori: Heathen most unholy! A terrible witch is trying to join his mission? The rotten stench of false gods permeates her, but one just needs to show her the Divine Truth and she will become a powerful ally.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 一位被伪星放过的骑士，自称与他志同道合，要把每一个异教徒都逐出阿斯特拉——可她没有看见光。等她看清真相，就不得不沐浴在祂的神圣光辉之下。
Ori: A knight spared by the false Star claims to share his goal of routing each and every heathen out of Astra, but she does not see the Light. Once she sees the Truth, she will have no choice but to bask in His Divine Radiance.

Context: Character description
EN: 作为许珀里翁教团的虔信者，索尔·伊格尼斯来到这片颓败之地只为了一件事：净化那些崇拜错误星辰的人。对他而言，只有一颗真正的星，而它从未失约于黎明。
Ori: A Devout of the Hyperion Order, Sol Ignis has come to these crestfallen lands for one thing only: to cleanse it of those worshiping the wrong star. To him, there is only one true star and it has never failed to hail the Dawn.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 一只老鼠似乎溜上了船。它没有犯下明显的罪，但所有害虫终究都要回窝。无所谓，光也会驱散这道影子。
Ori: A rat seems to have snuck aboard the ship. No apparent sin has been committed, but all vermin must return to nest eventually. No matter, the Light will vanquish this shadow, too.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 一个异教徒请求搭乘索尔的船。不是任务目标中的那个异教徒，但终究是异教徒。等阿斯特雷亚的圣战结束后，他的时辰是否就该到了？还是说他已经受够了惩罚？
Ori: A heathen has requested passage on Sol's vessel. Not the heathen targeted by the mission, but a heathen no less. Should his time come once the Astrean crusade is finished? Or is he punished enough?

Context: Character motivations
EN: 但这些异教徒，啊，这些异教徒。他们怎敢遮蔽天空，怎敢带来永恒的暮色？许珀里翁的神圣之光很快就会降临到他们身上。
Ori: But these heathens, oh, these heathens. How dare they veil the sky, how dare they bring forth everlasting twilight? Hyperion's divine Light will reach them soon enough.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 一个异教徒在港口跟他搭话？不，她不属于他们，她是贵族。带上她吧，也许她也能看见光。
Ori: One of the heathens, talking to him at port? No, she is not one of them, she is nobility. Bring her along, and maybe she can see the Light too.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 索尔想不出还有比他更不热心的圣战骑士，但拒绝一位盟友又是何道理？这个新来的女孩或许古怪，但她的温顺也许能孕育出最忠诚的忏悔。
Ori: Sol could not think of a more unenthusiastic Crusader, but who is he to turn down an ally? This new girl may be odd, but her meekness may beget penance most loyal.

Context: Character losing
EN: 有人会说，这已是索尔·伊格尼斯旅程中较好的结局了。如果索尔看到了等待自己的是什么，他或许也会同意。
Ori: Some might say this was the better outcome of Sol Ignis's journey. And if Sol saw what was coming for him, he might agree.

Context: Sol's team name
Character motivations
EN: 瞧，一个亵渎者乞求搭船。一个扭曲自然、自比神明的人。他声称要净化民众的疯狂。我们拭目以待。
Ori: Lo, a blasphemer begs passage aboard the ship. A twister of nature, one who plays God. He claims he will cleanse the folk of their madness. We shall see.

Context: Order of the procedurally-combined story elements. e.g. 'And then the heroes saved the day. Lyra went on to start her own clothing brand. Would things have been different if the player made different choices?' Each sentence in that example is a piece chosen depending on the player's party makeup. The spaces are for indenting
Universal end to every character's intro info
EN: 由于浓雾弥漫，两人只能抵达阿斯特雷亚最外围，被迫停靠在重商的德里瓦斯托共和国。他们会找到所寻之物吗？还是会被星尘吞没？请见证命运中一条可能的分岔丝线……
Ori: Due to the thick fog, the two could only make it to the outermost point of Astrea and were forced to dock at the mercantile Republic of Drivasto. Will they find what they seek? Or will they succumb to the Stardust? Bear witness to a possible stray thread of fate...

Context: Order of the procedurally-combined story elements. e.g. 'Lyra joined up with Cetus. She needed help to get home. Lyra is a noble. Cetus is a thief. They arrived at the island together.' Each sentence in that example is a piece chosen depending on the player's party makeup. The spaces are for indenting
Universal end to every character's losing state
EN: 若当初做出不同的选择，他们会走上同一条路吗？也许下一条命运之线不会这样磨损殆尽。
Ori: Would they have walked the same path if given different choices? Maybe the next thread of fate won't end up so frayed.

Context: Order of the procedurally-combined story elements.
Hint to the player on how their story was going when they lost
EN: 随着时间推移，<CharName>的道路似乎正渐渐迷失。
Ori: As time went on, <CharName>'s way seemed to be in the process of being lost.

Context: Hint to the player on how their story was going when they lost
EN: 直到此刻，<CharName>始终坚守着方向，从未偏离最初的目标。
Ori: Up until now, <CharName> was staying the course, never losing sight of the original goal.

Context: Hint to the player on how their story was going when they lost
EN: 整段旅程中，<CharName>的信念愈发坚定。
Ori: Throughout the journey, <CharName>'s conviction was growing ever-strong.

Context: Universal start to every character's losing state
EN: 此处标记着<CharName>旅程的提前终结。
Ori: Here marks the premature end of <CharName>'s journey.

Context: Name for a hero character
Character motivations
EN: 维加很恼火：要找到去阿斯特雷亚的船，唯一的办法就是跟一个显然对他的研究毫无兴趣的人分摊船费。无所谓，他想，只要能到那儿就行。
Ori: Annoyed, the only way Vega could find a boat to Astrea was to split the fare with someone very obviously uninterested in his research project. No matter, he thinks, he just needs to get there.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 在港口，维加看到一位骑士正登上开往阿斯特拉的船。他抓住机会冲到她身边，说明自己想找到治疗星盲症的方法。骑士听了很满意，便带他上船。
Ori: At port, Vega spotted a knight boarding a ship to Astra. Seeing his chance, he rushed to her side to explain he wants to find a cure for the Starblindness. Pleased at what she was hearing, the knight took him aboard.

Context: Character description
EN: 维加是出身名校、受人敬重的医生，一心想以任何方式扬名立万。嗅到机会的他，把目光投向了寻找治愈这场蚕食记忆之疫的方法。
Ori: Vega, an esteemed Doctor from a prestigious school, is determined to make a name for himself in any way he can. Sensing opportunity, he sets his sights on finding a cure for the memory-stealing affliction plaguing the land.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 苦于找不到出行途径，维加不得不放下身段，与一个流氓流浪汉分摊船费。他不知道自己怎么就被说服同行了，但想着到岸之后就能甩掉这个扒手。
Ori: Frustrated at his inability to procure a means of travel, Vega was forced below his usual standing to split the fare with a roguish vagabond. He has no idea how he was convinced to share his journey, but reckoned he could part with the cutpurse as soon as they arrived.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 急着弄到船票的维加很意外：有个男人不仅愿意跟他分摊船费，还全数替他付了。维加心动了，答应与新同伴一起前往阿斯特拉。
Ori: Desperate to get a ticket, Vega was surprised to have a man not just split the fare with him, but take it all upon himself. Smitten, Vega agreed to travel together with his new companion to Astra.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 尽管加入了队伍，维加仍比任何人都更把自己视为「求人不如求己」这句话的化身。他会在这里赢得名声……当然，顺路也救几条命。
Ori: Despite joining a team, more than anyone else, Vega sees himself as the embodiment of the phrase 'If you want something done, you must do it yourself'. Here he will find his fame... And save a few lives along the way, of course.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 正在寻找前往阿斯特雷亚的办法时，维加偶然得到了船票，而且对方还是位贵族！她似乎很乐意带他同行，正如他所料。毕竟他是去行善的。
Ori: Searching for the way to get to Astrea, Vega chances on his ticket, and a noble no less! She seemed happy enough to bring him along, as he expected. He was to do good, after all.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 从清晨到午后，从午后到黄昏，维加注意到港口只剩他和另一个人还没上船。维加问对方要去哪里，她答说想去阿斯特雷亚找一个人。目的地相同，两人便分摊船费同行。
Ori: As morning turned to afternoon, and afternoon turned to dusk, Vega noticed only he and one other remained at the port, ship-less. Vega asked where this person was going, and she replied her intention to find someone in Astrea. Sharing a destination, they split the fare and travelled together.

Context: Character motivations
EN: 让维加沮丧的是，唯一愿意载他上岛的船员竟是一群狂热的圣战骑士。维加平时并不信教，但觉得站在他们一边总比与他们为敌安全。
Ori: To Vega's dismay, the only crew willing to take him to the isle was a band of zealous crusaders. Usually not one for worship, Vega decided it was probably safer to be with them than against them.

Context: Character losing
EN: 维加终究没能写下属于自己的历史。到头来，他不过是又一个眼高手低的学生。
Ori: Vega never got to make his history. In the end, he was just another student who bit off more than he could chew.

Context: Vega's team name
Ori: The Only One for the Job

Name for an important non player unit
Name for an important non player unit

Name for a set of abilities units get by having this hero in the party
Description for Aniara's class
EN: 阿妮亚拉认为，人生所需只有魔法，以及运用魔法的灵巧。其余一切都是废物——如果敌人早就死光了，你还需要防什么？旅途中她得了许多称号，大多不太体面，但她偏爱「织血者」这个称呼。
Ori: Aniara believes you need nothing more in life than Magic and the Dexterity to use it. Everything else is worthless, what do you need to defend against if everyone's already dead? In her travels, she has picked up many names, most of them unsavoury, however she has a fondness for 'Bloodweaver'.

Context: Name for Aniara's class
Description for Azha's class
EN: 与传统的军队不同，德里瓦斯托的骑士身份不是靠头衔授予，而是靠实力挣来。阿莎退役时是名队长，恰好留着自己的盔甲，正好用在此刻。阿莎出色的力量来自严酷的训练，而她过人的魔抗则源于盔甲上的特殊衬板——或许当初装上它，正是出于对那位信奉帝国、精通魔法的邻居的忌惮。
Ori: Unlike traditional militaries, knighthood in Drivasto is not granted by title, it is earned. Azha retired a captain and serendipitously kept her armour for just such an occasion. Azha's increased Strength comes from harsh training, but her increased Resistance is due to special plating on the armour, perhaps placed there in fear of their imperialist, and magical, neighbours.

Context: Name for Azha's class
Name for a set of abilities units get by having this hero in the party
Description for Sol's class
EN: 许珀里翁教团的圣战骑士通常没有这般狂热。索尔·伊格尼斯似乎把他的职业推到了极限：力量上过度投入，其余各项修行全都抛在了身后。盔甲一旦被撕成碎片，也就挡不住什么了。
Ori: Crusaders of the Hyperion Order are not normally this passionate. Sol Ignis has seemingly stretched the limit of his profession, overdosing on Strength and leaving all other disciplines in the dust. Armour doesn't block much when it's torn to shreds.

Context: Name for Sol's class
Description for Vega's class
EN: 医生通常不会顶替士兵上战场，但维加觉得自己的才能对前线大有裨益。虽然灵巧与速度出众，维加却认为自己没必要抵抗魔法。勇敢与愚蠢之间那条界线，确实相当模糊。
Ori: Normally, Doctors don't take the place of soldiers on the battlefield, but Vega feels his talents can be a great benefit to the front lines. While high in Dexterity and Speed, Vega feels he does not need to be Resistant to magic. The line separating bravery and foolishness can be a blurry one indeed.

Context: Name for Vega's class
Name for a set of abilities units get by having this hero in the party
Description for the Fighter class
EN: 战士力量出众，但灵巧与魔抗偏弱，他们精通的是「大棒外交」。
Ori: High in Strength but weak in Dexterity and Resistance, Warriors are well-versed in big-stick diplomacy.

Context: Name for the Fighter class
Description for Draco's class
EN: 赌徒不是战士，德拉科的魔力也并非源自自身，那样的力量是加莱亚赐予的。不过德拉科也并非毫无可取之处——想不声不响地从袖中抽出一张王牌，动作得相当快才行。
Ori: Gamblers are not warriors, and Draco does not get his Magical power from within, such strength is granted by Galea. Draco is not without praises, however, one must be quite Speedy to pull an ace from your sleeve unnoticed.

Context: Name for Draco's class
Name for base abilities that all units have access to
Description for the King's class
EN: 卡登斯贵族人人受过战斗训练。但与女儿不同，阿里斯在魔法上没有天赋，于是以钢铁为伴。这并未动摇他对星辰的崇敬，只是这份倾向被他的头衔掩盖了。
Ori: Every member of Cadens nobility endures combat training, but unlike his daughter, Aries did not show aptitude for magic, so he trained with steel. This did not dissuade his reverence for the Stars, though such proclivities were overshadowed by his title.

Context: Name for the King's class
Description for the Knight class
EN: 骑士厚重的盔甲防御极高，能让最锋利的刀剑在战斗中变钝，代价则是速度与魔抗偏低。
Ori: A Knight's heavy armour can dull even the sharpest blades in combat due to its high Defense, but that comes at the cost of lower Speed and Resistance.

Context: Name for the Knight class
Name for a set of abilities units get by having this hero in the party
Description for the Mage class
EN: 法师最擅长的自然是魔法，但奥术修行往往拖慢身体的速度、削弱防御。
Ori: Naturally, a Mage's greatest skill is their mastery over Magic, but arcane training tends to slow the body's Speed and weakens Defense.

Context: Name for the Mage class
Description for Lyra's class
EN: 卡登斯帝国中有魔法天赋的贵族，会脱离传统的骑士训练，专攻一种配得上璀璨夜空的进攻型魔法。这样培养出的士兵兼具防御与魔力，但臃肿的制服会拖低灵巧与速度。
Ori: Imperial Cadens nobility with the aptitude for magic break away from the traditional Knight training and specialize in an offensive form of magic befitting the spectacular night sky. This creates a soldier with a unique blend of Defense and Magic, but the bulk of the uniform reduces Dexterity and Speed.

Context: Name for Lyra's class
Description for Maia's Doll's class
EN: 玛雅的人偶比她更强，但他们的潜力在被召唤的那一刻就已定格。只有她自身的成长才能提升她的手艺。
Ori: Maia's puppets are stronger than her, but their potential is set in stone the moment they are summoned. Only improvement in herself can improve her craft.

Context: Name for Maia's Doll's class
Name for a set of abilities units get by having this hero in the party
Description for the Mercenary class
EN: 岛上的「能手」以精通轻型与投射武器闻名，专攻灵巧与速度，但对魔法有致命弱点。
Ori: Known for being very skilled light and projectile weapon users, the Adepts of the isles train in Dexterity and Speed, but have an Achilles' heel to Magic.

Context: Name for the Mercenary class
Description for the Monk class
EN: 武僧多年修行，锤炼心身以抵抗魔法。但冥想对灵巧与防御并无助益。
Ori: Monks train for years to fortify their minds and bodies to be Resistant to magic. Meditation however does not do well for one's Dexterity or Defense.

Context: Name for the Monk class
Description for the Myrmidon class
EN: 尽管防御与魔抗不足，斥候最强的仍是速度，紧随其后的则是他们……等等，你刚才听见什么了吗？
Ori: Despite lacking in Defense and Resistance, a Scout's greatest strength is their Speed, followed closely by their ability to... say, did you hear that just now?

Description for Maia's Class
