Context: Tutorial text
EN: 炼金术士可以取走你不要的东西，将它们转化为其他物品。\n最多放入 3 件物品并点击“转化”，即可获得 1 件价值与其金币总值相近的物品。\n每次拜访最多可转化 3 次。
Ori: The Alchemist can take your unwanted things and transmute them into other Items.\nInput up to 3 Items and hit 'Transmute' to get an item of similar value to their total Gold value.\nYou are limited to 3 transmutations per visit.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 或者，如果你选中并长按，会打开一个\n环形菜单，松开按键即可选择你想要的\n项目。
Ori: Alternatively, if you select and hold, you'll open\na radial menu where you can select what you\nwant by lifting the button.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 优势与劣势由所装备的武器决定。\n拥有优势的单位获得 +1 威力与 +10 命中率。\n处于劣势的单位则承受 -1 威力与 -10 命中率。
Ori: Advantage and Disadvantage are determined by equipped Weapon.\nUnits with Advantage gain +1 Power and +10 Hit Chance.\nDisadvantaged Units suffer -1 Power and -10 Hit Chance.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 这是战斗后每个单位在所有攻击全部命中情况下\n可能的剩余生命。\n它不考虑攻击未命中或暴击的情况。
Ori: This is the potential resulting HP each Unit will have after the\nFight if all Attacks successfully land.\nIt does not take into account if an Attack were to miss or Crit.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
以下是其余计算所得的属性。
伤害为每次攻击的总伤害，
命中为命中率，
暴击为暴击率。
Ori:
These are the rest of the calculated stats.
DMG is total Damage per Attack,
HIT is Hit Chance,
and CRIT is Critical Hit Chance.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 你也可以在各个面板上方看到每个单位的状态效果。\n普通敌人会获得 1 个随机改变属性的技能。\n这些每局都不同，务必保持警惕。
Ori: You can also see each Unit's status effects above their respective panels.\nNormal Enemies are granted a random stat-changing Skill.\nThese are different each game, so be on your toes.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 这是每个单位当前装备的武器\n以及其所处的地形。\n将光标移到地形上可查看其效果。
Ori: These are each Unit's currently equipped Weapons\nand what terrain they are standing on.\nMove the Cursor over the terrain to see its effects.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 选择你单位射程内的 1 个敌方单位即可开始战斗。\n作为快捷方式，你也可以在移动过程中\n直接选择敌方单位。
Ori: Select an Enemy Unit within your Unit's RNG to start a Fight.\nAs a shortcut, you can also just select an\nEnemy Unit during movement.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 你也可以通过先选中消耗品物品、\n再选择单位来使用它们。\n这通常会结束该单位的回合。
Ori: You can also use Consumable Items by selecting them\nand then selecting Unit.\nThat usually ends the Unit's turn.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 在遭遇战之间，你可以在商队中管理单位的装备\n并使用治疗药水等消耗品。
Ori: You can manage your Units' Equipment and use Consumables\nsuch as Health Potions in the Caravan in between Encounters.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 危险区域按钮可显示敌方队伍的射程范围。\n选中单个敌方单位可查看其各自的射程。
Ori: The Danger Zone button lets you see the area in range of the Enemy Team.\nYou can see the range of individual Enemy Units by selecting them.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 将光标移到单位上并选中它。\n然后你可以选择其移动位置。\n（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori: Move the Cursor to a Unit and Select them.\nFrom there you can choose where they'll move.\n(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 你只能在遭遇战开始前部署与撤下单位。\n通过选中单位来重新部署，通过取消来撤下。\n（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori: You can only deploy and undeploy Units before starting an Encounter.\nReposition Units by Selecting and undeploy by Canceling.\n(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 你可以通过先选中物品、\n再选择丢弃区域来丢弃它们。
Ori: You can discard Items by selecting them\nand then selecting the Discard area.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 当你某个单位的生命降至 0 时，它会进入倒下状态。 用另一个单位救援它，即可将其送回商队。 遭遇战结束时仍处于倒下的单位将永久失去。 若你的队长倒下，游戏将结束。
Ori: When one of your Units' HP hits 0, they enter a Downed state. Saving them with another Unit sends them back to the Caravan. Any downed Units by Encounter's end are permanently lost. If your Leader is Downed, the game ends.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 这是该单位的装备。\n你可以在此菜单中自由整理物品并装备武器。
Ori: This is the Unit's Equipment.\nYou can freely arrange Items and equip Weapons in this Menu.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 每个单位装备栏的第 1 格即为其装备的武器。\n将武器移入或移出此处即可装备与卸下。
Ori: The first slot in every Unit's Equipment is their equipped Weapon.\nMove weapons in and out of here to equip and unequip them.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 战斗与技能可为你的单位提供经验。\n每项主属性都会根据该单位的属性成长\n独立获得经验并提升。
Ori: Combat and Skills can award your Units Experience.\nEach Primary Stat gains Experience and levels up\nindividually based on the Unit's stat growths.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 在世界地图上选中 1 个遭遇战即可前往。\n每一幕都以 1 个起始遭遇战开始。
Ori: Move to an Encounter on the World Map by selecting it.\nEvery Act starts with one starting Encounter.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
看看这个！
游戏中几乎任何内容都可以这样操作，甚至包括地形
与武器描述。
若想知道某个东西的含义，试着把光标移到上面。
按取消键可关闭锁定的提示框。
（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori:
Check it out!
You can do this with almost everything in the game, even the Terrain
and Weapon Descriptions.
If you want to know what something means, try moving the cursor over it.
Press Cancel to close locked Tooltips.
(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 当 7 项属性提升后，该单位提升 1 级。\n单位升级时，会根据其成长获得最大生命，\n并可学习 1 个新技能。
Ori: After 7 Stats level up, the Unit gains a level.\nWhen a Unit levels up, they gain Max HP depending on its growth\nand they can learn a new Skill.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 选中 1 个遭遇战即可前往。\n在世界地图上你只能向前移动，\n因此请谨慎选择！
Ori: Select an Encounter to navigate to it.\nYou can only move forward on the World Map,\nso choose carefully!

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 此提示框中还有一些未解释的内容。\n按下提示框锁定键，即可弄清它们是什么。\n（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori: There's some unexplained things in this Tooltip.\nPress the Tooltip Lock button it to figure out what they are.\n(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 既然已经锁定，你就可以把光标移到上面查看更多提示框。
Ori: Now that it's locked, you can move the cursor over it for more Tooltips.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 遭遇战也有轮数限制。\n让我们用提示框锁定系统进一步了解它们。\n将光标移到轮数限制上开始吧。
Ori: Encounters also have Round Limits.\nLet's learn more about them using the Tooltip Lock system.\nMove the cursor over the Round Limit to get started.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 在该单位移动范围内的任意可用格子中选中 1 格即可移动过去。\n之后你就能为其下达行动指令。
Ori: Select any available Tile in the Unit's movement range to move there.\nAfterwards you'll be able to give them action commands.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 完成遭遇战的目标即可获得战利品。\n大多数目标会结束该遭遇战，并迫使你继续前进。
Ori: You are awarded Loot by completing the Encounter's Objectives.\nMost Objectives will end the Encounter and force you to move on.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 完成攻城遭遇战将结束本幕。\n若你愿意，也可以提前前往攻城遭遇战。\n现在出发吧，踏上你的旅程！
Ori: Finishing the Siege Encounter will end the Act.\nIf you want, you can navigate to the Siege Encounter early as well.\nNow Go, be off on your journey!

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 战斗类遭遇战包括小规模冲突与战斗。\n商店、宝箱、竞技场与篝火不会增加星尘。
Ori: Combat Encounters include Skirmishes and Battles.\nShops, Treasure Chests, Arenas, and Campfires will not increase Stardust.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
一旦达到星尘上限，你将被迫
前往结束本幕的攻城遭遇战。
不过厄运会降临到你的队伍身上，所以尽量不要
在此时离得太远。
Ori:
Once the Stardust Limit is reached, you will be forced
to make your way to the Act-ending Siege encounter.
However, bad fortune will fall upon your team, so try not to
be too far away when this happens.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 战斗类遭遇战会耗费时间，因此\n每次之后星尘都会积聚。
Ori: Combat Encounters take time, so the\nStardust will build after each one.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
选择一个行动通常会结束该单位的回合，
你也可以选择不行动直接结束。
随时按取消键返回。
（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori:
Choosing an action usually ends a Unit's turn,
or you can choose to end it without acting.
Press Cancel to go back anytime.
(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 有些敌方单位其实是可招募的民兵单位。\n走到他们身边，从行动菜单中招募他们。\n……或者干脆打一场来满足你的杀意。
Ori: Some Enemy Units are actually recruitable Militia Units.\nWalk up to them and Recruit them from the Action Menu.\n...Or just fight them to satiate your bloodlust.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
在此列表中选中未部署的单位即可部署。
在某些遭遇战中，你可能无法部署队伍中的所有单位。
若使用手柄，按下部署模式键可切换焦点。
（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori:
Deploy an undeployed Unit by selecting them in this list.
You might not be able to deploy every Unit in your party in certain Encounters.
If using a controller, press the Deployment Mode button to switch focus.
(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
打造队伍的另一种方式是使用记忆，
它们带有全队范围的效果。
可通过随机事件、商店，或战胜强敌的
战斗遭遇战来收集。
Ori:
Another way to build your team is with Memories which
contain team-wide effects.
Collect these in Random Events, Shops, or by winning
Battle Encounters against strong Enemies.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 每次遭遇战之后，你可以前往任何\n有道路相连的遭遇战。
Ori: After each Encounter, you can move to any\nEncounter connected by a road.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 这是战斗预测，会告诉你战斗可能的结果。\n将鼠标悬停在武器上即可查看其预测。
Ori: This is the combat forecast, which tells you the potential outcomes of a Fight.\nHover over a weapon to see its forecast.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 最后，若你想更改游戏体验中的任何内容，\n无论是操作、画面风格、玩法调整，还是关闭剧情，\n都可以在系统设置菜单中进行。
Ori: And finally, if there's anything you want to change about the gameplay experience,\nwhether it be the controls, graphical style, gameplay tweaks, or disabling the story,\nyou can do so in the System Settings menu.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 叮！ 你升级了，可以选择 1 个技能来学习。 有些技能占用技能栏，有些则不占用。 英雄单位的技能栏比民兵更多。
Ori: Ding! You've leveled up, so you get to choose a skill to learn. Some skills take up Skill Slots, and some don't. Hero Units have more Skill Slots than Militia.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 星尘是一种恶意的迷雾，会中止一切经验获取，\n并在其存续期间每轮吸取每个单位的生命。
Ori: The Stardust is a malevolent fog that halts all Experience gain\nand saps HP from each Unit every Round it is active.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 选择 1 件武器即可开始战斗，或\n按取消键退出，进行战术撤退。
Ori: Start the Fight by selecting a Weapon or back\nout by pressing Cancel for a tactical retreat.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 准备完毕后，按下此按钮开始遭遇战。
Ori: Press this button to start the Encounter once you're done.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 主属性及其成长由该单位的职业与其自身特质\n共同决定。\n它们根据获得的经验而成长。
Ori: Primary Stats and their Growths are based on a mixture\nof the Unit's class and their own individuality.\nThey grow based on Experience gained.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 副属性主要来源于主属性与装备。\n将光标移到任意属性上可查看其计算方式。
Ori: Secondary Stats are mostly derived from Primary Stats and Equipment.\nMove the Cursor over any Stat to see how it is calculated.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 你可以在此查看单位的可用技能列表。将光标移到上面可获取更多信息。\n若有未解释的内容，锁定提示框后将光标移上去即可。\n（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori: You can See a Unit's list of available Skills here. Move the Cursor over them for more info.\nIf there is something unexplained, lock the Tooltip and Cursor over that.\n(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
你也可以选中此按钮查看单位的可用技能组。
技能组是单位在升级时可供选择的
技能池。单位的技能组由其
职业、武器类型及其他一些因素决定。
Ori:
You can also Select this button to see the Unit's available Skill Sets.
Skill Sets are the pool of Skills a Unit might be able to choose
from during Level-Up. A Unit's Skill Sets are determined by their
Class, Weapon Styles, and some other factors.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 若单位有任何状态效果，会显示在这里。\n将光标移到上面可查看其作用。\n在此菜单之外，它们也会显示在单位生命条下方。
Ori: If a Unit has any Status Effects, they show up here.\nMove the Cursor over them to see what they do.\nThese also show up under the Unit's HP bar outside of this menu.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 单位菜单包含与该单位相关的所有信息。\n你可以在此查看其属性、状态、装备与技能。
Ori: The Unit menu contains all of the information pertaining to a Unit.\nYou can see their Stats, Status, equipment, and Skills here.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 单位可用的武器类型同样取决于其职业\n与自身特质。有些武器类型当前即可使用，有些\n需要学习，还有一些则该单位无法学会。
Ori: A Unit's usable Weapon Styles are also based on their Class\nand individuality. Some Weapon Styles are usable now, some\nmust be learned, and others are impossible for the Unit to learn.

Context: Tutorial text
EN:
若提示框中出现未解释的关键词，
你可以用提示框锁定键将其锁定，然后把
光标移到该词上以获取另一个提示框。
（见屏幕右下角的操作提示。）
Ori:
If a tooltip has an unexplained key word,
you can lock with the Lock Tooltip button and move the
Cursor over it to get another tooltip.
(See the controls on the bottom right of the Screen.)

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 若想知道某个东西是什么，\n试着把光标移到上面，它会显示一个提示框。
Ori: If you want to know what something is,\ntry moving the Cursor over it, it will show you a tooltip.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 此面板是武器三角与魔法三角的提示。\n按下其按钮即可显示或隐藏。
Ori: This panel is a reminder of the Weapon and Magic triangles.\nYou can show and hide it by pressing its button.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 遭遇战也有轮数限制。\n逗留太久，就会招来星尘。
Ori: Encounters also have Round Limits.\nLinger too long and you will invite the Stardust.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 单位列表按钮可显示遭遇战中各队伍的构成。\n它会标出敌方首领与可招募民兵。\n选中任意单位即可将镜头聚焦于其身上。
Ori: The Unit List button shows you the makeup of each team in an Encounter.\nIt denotes Enemy Leaders and Recruitable Militia.\nSelect anyone to focus on them.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 将光标移到单位上并选中它。\n然后你可以选择其移动位置。
Ori: Move the Cursor to a Unit and Select them.\nFrom there you can choose where they'll move.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 有些武器在装备时会赋予单位 1 个技能。\n武器技能通常需要单位达到一定的\n灵巧值才能开始使用。
Ori: Some weapons grant a Skill to the Unit when equipped.\nWeapon Skills normally need the Unit to have a certain\nDEX level to begin to use them.

Context: Tutorial text
EN: 世界地图可预览你在本幕中的推进进度。
Ori: The World Map previews your progression through the Act.
